33.d: अ॒स्याजरा॑सो द॒माम॒रित्रा॑ अ॒र्चद्धू॑मासो अ॒ग्नयः॑ पाव॒काः । श्वि॑ती॒चयः॑ श्वा॒त्रासो॑ भुर॒ण्यवो॑ वन॒र्षदो॑ वा॒यवो॒ न सोमाः॑ ।।
33.e:
-THIRD.

His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes,
 whose smoke is shining,
 White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated
 in the wood: like winds are Somas.

33.d: हर॑यो धु॒मके॑तवो॒ वात॑जूता॒ उप॒ द्यवि॑ । यत॑न्ते॒ वृथ॑ग॒ग्नयः॑ ।।
33.e:
Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind,
 aloft to heaven
 Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.
 Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great
 sacrifice;
 Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

33.d: यजा॑ नो मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ यजा॑ दे॒वाँ ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् । अग्ने॒ यक्षि॒ स्वं दम॑म् ।।
33.e:
Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the
 Gods:
 As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

33.d: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ॒ अश्वाँ॑ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः ।।
33.e:
To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in
 succession nourishes an infant.
 One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and
 fair-shining is be with the other.

33.d: द्वे विरू॑पे चरतः॒ स्वर्थे॑ अ॒न्यान्या॑ व॒त्समुप॑ धापयेते । हरि॑र॒न्यस्यां॒ भव॑ति स्व॒धावा॑ञ्छु॒क्रो अ॒न्यस्यां॑ ददृशे सु॒वर्चाः॑ ।।
33.e:
Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker,
 best at worship, to be praised at rites,
 Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine,
 bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

33.d: अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्यः॑ । यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॑ वि॒शेवि॑शे ।।
33.e:
Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice a thousand, and
 three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni,
 For him spread sacred grass, balmed him with butter, and
 stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

33.d: त्रीणि॑ श॒ता त्री स॒हस्रा॑ण्य॒ग्निं त्रिँ॒शच्च॑ दे॒वा नव॑ चासपर्यन् । अौ॑क्षन्घृतै॒रस्तृ॑णन्ब॒र्हिर॑स्मा॒ आदिद्धोता॑रं॒ न्य॑सादयन्त ।।
33.e:
Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara,
 born in holy Order,
 The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their
 mouths, the Gods have generated.

33.d: मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् । क॒विँ स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः ।।
33.e:
May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the
 love of song
 Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.

33.d: अ॒ग्निर्वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनद्द्रविण॒स्युर्वि॑प॒न्यया॑ । समि॑द्धः शु॒क्र आहु॑तः ।।
33.e:
With the All-Gods, with Indra and with Vâyu drink the
 Soma mead,
 O Agni, after Mitra's laws.

33.d: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः ।।
33.e:
When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him,
 down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture.
 Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful
 host benevolent and blameless.

33.d: आ यदि॒षे नृ॒पतिं॒ तेज॒ आन॒ट्शुचि॒ रेतो॒ निषि॑क्तं द्यौर॒भीके॑ । अ॒ग्निः शर्ध॑मनव॒द्यं युवा॑नँ स्वा॒ध्यं॑ जनयत्सू॒दय॑च्च ।।
33.e:
Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent
 be thine effulgent splendours.
 Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample
 down the might of those who hate us.

33.d: अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑ मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय॒ तव॑ द्यु॒म्नान्यु॑त्त॒मानि॑ सन्तु । सं जा॑स्प॒त्यँ सु॒यम॒मा कृ॑णुष्व शत्रूय॒ताम॒भि ति॑ष्ठा॒ महाँ॑सि ।।
33.e:
We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams’
 glow: hear our great laud, O Agni.
 The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength,
 mid Gods, like Vâyu in thy bounty.

33.d: त्वाँ हि म॒न्द्रत॑ममर्कशोकैर्ववृ॒महे॒ महि॑ नः॒ श्रोष्य॑ग्ने । इन्द्रं॒ न त्वा॒ शव॑सा दे॒वता॑ वा॒युं पृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑सा॒ नृत॑माः ।।
33.e:
O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to
 thee,
 Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in
 gifts their stalls of kine.

33.d: त्वे अ॑ग्ने स्वाहुत प्रि॒यासः॑ सन्तु सू॒रयः॑ । य॒न्तारो॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो॒ जना॑नामू॒र्वान्दय॑न्त॒ गोना॑म् ।।
33.e:
Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of
 escort Gods.
 Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them
 upon the sacred grass.

33.d: श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त्कर्ण॒ वह्नि॑भिर्देवैरग्ने स॒याव॑भिः । आ सी॑दन्तु ब॒र्हिषि॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा प्रा॑त॒र्यावा॑णो अध्व॒रम् ।।
33.e:
The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received
 as Guest in all men's houses,
 Agni who hath secured the Gods’ high favour, may he be
 gracious to us, Jâtavedas.

33.d: विश्वे॑षा॒मदि॑तिर्य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ विश्वे॑षा॒मति॑थि॒र्मानु॑षाणाम् । अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॒मव॑ आवृणा॒नः सु॑मृडी॒को भ॑वतु जा॒तवे॑दाः ।।
33.e:
In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from
 all sin before Mitra and Varuna,
 May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this
 gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

33.d: म॒हो अ॒ग्नेः स॑मिधा॒नस्य॒ शर्म॒ण्यना॑गा मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे स्व॒स्तये॑ । श्रेष्ठे॑ स्याम सवि॒तुः सवी॑मनि॒ तद्दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ अ॒द्या वृ॑णीमहे ।।
33.e:
Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers

approached
 thy holy cult, O Indra.
 Come thou to us as to his team comes Vâyu. Thou through
 our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.

33.d: आप॑श्चित्पिप्यु स्त॒र्यो॒ न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्नृ॒तं ज॑रि॒तार॑स्त इन्द्र । या॒हि वा॒युर्न नि॒युतो॑ नो॒ अच्छा॒ त्वँ हि धी॒भिर्दय॑से॒ वि वाजा॑न् ।।
33.e:
Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the
 sacrifice.
 The handles twain are wrought of gold.

33.d: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑ ।।
33.e:
Now when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra,
 Aryaman,
 Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.

33.d: यद॒द्य सूर॒ उदि॒ते ना॑गा मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा । सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता भगः॑ ।।
33.e:
Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the
 heaven and earth;

Supply the liquid to the Bull.
 Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.

33.d: आ सु॒ते सि॑ञ्चत॒ श्रियँ॒ रोद॑स्योरभि॒श्रिय॑म् । र॒सा द॑धीत वृष॒भम् ।।
33.e:
As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he
 travels, clothed in splendour.
 That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform,
 hath reached the eternal waters.

33.d: आ॒तिष्ठ॑न्तं॒ परि॒ विश्वे॑ अभूष॒ञ्छ्रियो॒ वसा॑नश्चरति॒ स्वरो॑चिः । म॒हत्तद्वृष्णो॒ असु॑रस्य॒ नामा वि॒श्वरू॑पो अ॒मृता॑नि तस्थौ ।।
33.e:
I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who
 is good to all men, who pervadeth all;
 Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose
 fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

33.d: प्र वो॑ म॒हे मन्द॑माना॒यान्ध॒सो र्चा॑ वि॒श्वान॑राय विश्वा॒भुवे॑ । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ यस्य॒ सुम॑खँ॒ सहो॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॒ रोद॑सी सप॒र्यतः॑ ।।
33.e:
Great is their fuel, strung their laud, wide is their sacrificial
 post
 Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.

33.d: बृ॒हन्निदि॒ध्म ए॑षां॒ भूरि॑ श॒स्तं पृ॒थुः स्वरुः॑ । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ।।
33.e:
Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the
 Soma feasts,
 Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.

33.d: इन्द्रेहि॒ मत्स्यन्ध॑सो॒ विश्वे॑भिः सोम॒पर्व॑भिः । म॒हाँ अ॑भि॒ष्टिरोज॑सा ।।
33.e:
Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew
 the wily leader of enchanters.
 He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and
 made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.

33.d: इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रम॑वृणो॒च्छर्ध॑नीतिः॒ प्र मा॒यिना॑ममिना॒द्वर्प॑णीतिः । अह॒न्व्यँ॑समु॒शध॒ग्वने॑ष्वा॒विर्धेना॑ अकृणोद्रा॒म्याणा॑म् ।।
33.e:
Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra,
 Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose?
 Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of
 Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us.
 Indra, great in his power and might. Ne’er art thou fruitless.
 Never art thou neglectful.

33.d: कुत॒स्त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ माहि॑नः॒ सन्नेको॑ यासि सत्पते॒ किं त॑ इ॒त्था । सं पृ॑च्छसे समरा॒णः शु॑भानैर्वो॒चेस्तन्नो॑ हरिवो॒ यत्ते॑ अ॒स्मे । म॒हाँ इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा । क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि । क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छसि ।।
33.e:
Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who
 would fain burst through the stall of cattle,
 Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons
 are many and her streams a thousand.

33.d: आ तत्त॑ इन्द्रा॒यवः॑ पनन्ता॒भि य ऊ॒र्वं गोम॑न्तं॒ तितृ॑त्सान् । स॑कृ॒त्स्वं॒ ये पु॑रुपु॒त्रां म॒हीँ स॒हस्र॑धारां बृह॒तीं दुदु॑क्षन् ।।
33.e:
To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy
 desire hath been gratified by my laud.
 In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the
 Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

33.d: इ॒मां ते॒ धियं॒ प्र भ॑रे म॒हो म॒हीम॒स्य स्तो॒त्रे धि॒षणा॒ यत्त॑ आन॒जे । तमु॑त्स॒वे च॑ प्रस॒वे च॑ सास॒हिमिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वासः॒ शव॑सामद॒न्ननु॑ ।।
33.e:
May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead,
 giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life;
 He who, wind-urged, in person guard our offspring well,
 hath nourished them with food and shone o’er many a
 land.

33.d: वि॒भ्राड्बृ॒हत्पि॑बतु सो॒म्यं मध्वायु॒र्दध॑द्य॒ज्ञप॑ता॒ववि॑ह्रुतम् । वात॑जूतो॒ यो अ॑भि॒रक्ष॑ति॒ त्मना॑ प्र॒जाः पु॑पोष पुरु॒धा वि रा॑जति ।।
33.e:
His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all
 that lives,
 Sûrya, that all may look on him.

33.d: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तवः॑ । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्यँ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
33.e:
Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest
 upon one
 Actively stirring mid the folk—

33.d: येना॑ पावक॒ चक्ष॑सा भुर॒ण्यन्तं॒ जनाँ॒ अनु॑ । त्वं व॑रुण॒ पश्य॑सि ।।
33.e:
Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car:
 Bedew our sacrifice with stead.
 Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.

33.d: दै॑व्यावध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑तँ॒ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञँ सम॑ञ्जाथे । तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ । अ॒यं वे॒नः । चि॒त्रम्दे॒वाना॑म् ।।
33.e:
Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as
 sacred food come to our synod,
 That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may
 gladden at your visit all our people.

33.d: आ न॒ इडा॑भिर्वि॒दथे॑ सुश॒स्ति वि॒श्वान॑रः सवि॒ता दे॒व ए॑तु । अपि॒ यथा॑ युवानो॒ मत्स॑था नो॒ विश्वं॒ जग॑दभिपि॒त्वे म॑नी॒षा ।।
33.e:
Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou Surya hast risen on to-day,
 That, Indra, all is in thy power.

33.d: यद॒द्य कच्च॑ वृत्रहन्नु॒दगा॑ अ॒भि सू॑र्य । सर्वं॒ तदि॑न्द्र ते॒ वशे॑ ।।
33.e:
Swift, visible to all art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light,
 Illuming all the radiant realm.

33.d: त॒रणि॑र्वि॒श्वद॑र्शतो ज्योति॒ष्कृद॑सि सूर्य । विश्व॒मा भा॑सि रोच॒नम् ।।
33.e:
This is the Godhead, this the might of Sûrya: he hath
 withdrawn what spread o’er work unfinished.
 When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight
 over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

33.d: तत्सूर्य॑स्य देव॒त्वं तन्म॑हि॒त्वं म॒ध्या कर्तो॒र्वित॑तँ॒ सं ज॑भार । य॒देदयु॑क्त ह॒रितः॑ स॒धस्था॒दाद्रात्री॒ वास॑स्तनुते सि॒मस्मै॑ ।।
33.e:
In the sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth that Varuna
 and Mitra may behold it.
 His Bay Steeds well maintain their power eternal, at one
 time bright, and darksome at another.

33.d: तन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्याभि॒चक्षे॒ सूर्यो॑ रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ द्योरु॒पस्थे॑ । अ॑न॒न्तम॒न्यद्रुश॑दस्य॒ पाजः॑ कृ॒ष्णम॒न्यद्ध॒रितः॒ सं भ॑रन्ति ।।
33.e:
Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great.
 As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea,
 verily thou, God, art great.

33.d: बण्म॒हाँ अ॑सि सूर्य॒ बडा॑दित्य म॒हाँ अ॑सि । म॒हस्ते॑ स॒तो म॑हि॒मा प॑नस्यते॒ द्धा दे॑व म॒हाँ अ॑सि ।।
33.e:
Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God,
 art great.
 Thou by thy greatness art the Gods’ Home-Priest, divine,
 far-spread, unconquerable light.

33.d: बट्सू॑र्य॒ श्रव॑सा म॒हाँ अ॑सि स॒त्रा दे॑व म॒हाँ अ॑सि । म॒ह्ना दे॒वाना॑मसु॒र्यः॑ पु॒रोहि॑तो वि॒भु ज्योति॒रदा॑भ्यम् ।।
33.e:
Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all
 good things.
 When he who will be horn is born with power we look to
 treasures as our heritage.

33.d: श्राय॑न्त इव॒ सूर्यं॒ विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य भक्षत । वसू॑नि जा॒ते जन॑मान॒ ओज॑सा॒ प्रति॑ भा॒गं न दी॑धिम ।।
33.e:
To-day, ye Gods, when Sûrya hath ascended, deliver us
 front trouble and dishonour.
 This boon may Varuna and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and
 Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

33.d: अ॒द्या दे॑वा॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ निरँह॑सः पिपृ॒ता निर॑व॒द्यात् । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑तिः॒ सिन्धुः॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः॑ ।।
33.e:
Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest
 the immortal and the mortal,
 Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God,
 beholding living creatures.

33.d: आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च । हि॑र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न् ।।
33.e:
Soft to the tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go
 like Kings amid the band around them,
 At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Vâyu, and
 Pûshan with his team to bless us.

33.d: प्र वा॑वृजे सुप्र॒या ब॒र्हिरे॑षा॒मा वि॒श्पती॑व॒ बीरि॑ट इयाते । वि॒शाम॒क्तोरु॒षसः॑ पू॒र्वहू॑तौ वा॒युः पू॒षा स्व॒स्तये॑ नि॒युत्वा॑न् ।।
33.e:
Indra, Vâyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga,
 Âdityas, and the Marut host.

33.d: इ॑न्द्रवा॒यू बृह॒स्पतिं॑ मि॒त्राग्निं पू॒षणं॒ भग॑म् । आ॑दि॒त्यान्मारु॑तं ग॒णम् ।।
33.e:
Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids:
 Both make us rich exceedingly!

33.d: वरु॑णः प्रावि॒ता भु॑वन्मि॒त्रो विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभिः॑ । कर॑तां नः सु॒राध॑सः ।।
33.e:
Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut
 host, us who are kith and kin to you.
 Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods.
 Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye
 Visvedevas who protect.

33.d: अधि॑ न इन्द्रेषां॒ विष्णो॑ सजा॒त्या॑नाम् । इ॒ता मरु॑तो॒ अश्वि॑ना । तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ । अ॒यं वे॒नः । ये दे॒वासः॑ । आ न॒ इडा॑भिः । विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मधु॑ । ओमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतः ।।
33.e:
O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and
 Marut host, and Vishnu.
 May both Nâsatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pûshan,
 Sarasvatî, Bhaga accept us.

33.d: अग्न॒ इन्द्र॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ देवाः॒ शर्धः॒ प्र य॑न्त॒ मारु॑तो॒त वि॑ष्णो । उ॒भा नास॑त्या रु॒द्रो अध॒ ग्नाः पू॒षा भगः॒ सर॑स्वती जुषन्त ।।
33.e:
Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains,
 Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven,
 Vishnu I call, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa,
 Savitar that they may help.

33.d: इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी मि॒त्रावरु॒णादि॑तिँ॒ स्वः॑ पृथि॒वीं द्यां म॒रुतः॒ पर्व॑ताँ अ॒पः । हु॒वे विष्णुं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॒ भगं॒ नु शँसँ॑ सवि॒तार॑मू॒तये॑ ।।
33.e:
With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to
 battle at the death of Vritra,
 The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May
 Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.

33.d: अ॒स्मे रु॒द्रा मे॒हना॒ पर्व॑तासो वृत्र॒हत्ये॒ भर॑हूतौ स॒जोषाः॑ । यः शँस॑ते स्तुव॒ते धायि॑ प॒ज्र इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा अ॒स्माँ अ॑वन्तु दे॒वाः ।।
33.e:
Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing
 in my heart I may approach you.
 Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye
 Holy, from the pit and falling.

33.d: अ॒र्वाञ्चो॑ अ॒द्या भ॑वता यजत्रा॒ आ वो॒ हार्दि॒ भय॑मानो व्ययेयम् । त्राध्वं॑ नो देवा नि॒जुरो॒ वृक॑स्य॒ त्राध्वं॑ क॒र्ताद॑व॒पदो॑ यजत्राः ।।
33.e: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XVIII. 31.

33.d: विश्वे॑ अ॒द्य म॒रुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती विश्वे॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नयः॒ समि॑द्धाः । विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒सा ग॑मन्तु॒ विश्व॑मस्तु॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ वाजो॑ अ॒स्मे ।।
33.e:
Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit
 heaven and air's mid-region.
 All ye; O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon
 this sacred grass be joyful.

33.d: विश्वे॑ देवाः शृणु॒तेमँ हवं॑ मे॒ ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ य उप॒ द्यवि॒ ष्ठ । ये अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वा उ॒त वा॒ यज॑त्रा आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयध्वम् ।।
33.e:
For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of
 all portions, immortality.
 Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence,
 life succeeding life.

33.d: दे॒वेभ्यो॒ हि प्र॑थ॒मं य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्यो मृत॒त्वँ सु॒वसि॑ भा॒गमु॒त्तंअम् । आदिद्दा॒मानँ॑ सवित॒र्व्यू॑र्णुषे नूची॒ना जी॑वि॒ता मानु॑षेभ्यः ।।
33.e:
I with a lofty song call hither Vâyu all-bounteous, filler of
 his car, most wealthy.
 Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses,
 impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.

33.d: प्र वा॒युमच्छा॑ बृह॒ती म॑नी॒षा बृ॒हद्र॑यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रँ रथ॒प्राम् । द्यु॒तद्या॑मा नि॒युतः॒ पत्य॑मानः क॒विः क॒विमि॑यक्षसि प्रयज्यो ।।
33.e: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed, etc., as in VII. 8.

33.d: इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒राग॑तम् । +इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि ।।
33.e:
Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna,
 Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

33.d: मि॒त्रँ हु॑वे पू॒तद॑क्षं॒ वरु॑णं च रि॒शाद॑सम् । धियं॑ घृ॒ताचीँ॒ साध॑न्ता ।।
33.e:
Nâsatyas, Wonder-workers, yours are these libations with
 clipt grass.
 Come ye whose paths are bright with glow.

33.d: दस्रा॑ यु॒वाक॑वः सु॒ता नास॑त्या वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । आ या॑तँ रुद्रवर्तनी । तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ । अ॒यं वे॒नः ।।
33.e:
When Saramâ had, found the mountain's fissure, that vast
 and ancient place she plundered
thoroughly
.
 In the floods’ van she led them forth, light-footed: she who
 well knew came first unto their lowing.

33.d: वि॒दद्यदी॑ स॒रमा॑ रु॒ग्णमद्रे॒र्महि॒ पाथः॑ पू॒र्व्यँ स॒ध्र्य॑क्कः । अग्रं॑ नयत्सु॒पद्यक्ष॑राणा॒मच्छा॒ रवं॑ प्रथ॒मा जा॑न॒ती गा॑त् ।।
33.e:
For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way
 than this Vaisvânara Agni.
 The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvânara
 to win the land in battle.

33.d: न॒हि स्पश॒मवि॑दन्न॒न्यम॒स्माद्वै॑श्वान॒रात्पु॑रए॒तार॑म॒ग्नेः । एमे॑नमवृधन्न॒मृता॒ अम॑र्त्यं वैश्वान॒रं क्षै॑त्रजित्याय दे॒वाः ।।
33.e:
The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke:
 May they be kind to one like me.

33.d: उ॒ग्रा वि॑घ॒निना॒ मृध॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी ह॑वामहे । ता नो॑ मृडात ई॒दृशे॑ ।।
33.e:
Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him as he is purified,
 Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

33.d: उपा॑स्मै गायता नरः॒ पव॑माना॒येन्द॑वे । अ॒भि दे॒वाँ इय॑क्षते ।।
33.e:
Drink Soma, Indra, handed with the Maruts who, Boon
 Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter,
 ’Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now
 rejoice in thee, the holy singers.

33.d: ये त्वा॑हि॒हत्ये॑ मघव॒न्नव॑र्ध॒न्ये शा॑म्ब॒रे ह॑रिवो॒ ये गवि॑ष्टौ । ये त्वा॑ नू॒नम॑नु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्राः॒ पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोमँ॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भिः॑ ।।
33.e:
Thou vast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting,
 strongest, full of pride and courage.
 There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his
 most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

33.d: जनि॑ष्ठा उ॒ग्रः सह॑से तु॒राय॑ म॒न्द्र ओजि॑ष्ठो बहु॒लाभि॑मानः । अव॑र्ध॒न्निन्द्रं॑ म॒रुत॑श्चि॒दत्र॑ मा॒ता यद्वी॒रं द॒धन॒द्धनि॑ष्ठा ।।
33.e:
O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side,
 Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

33.d: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न॒स्माक॑म॒र्धमा ग॑हि । म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ ।।
33.e:
Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands.
 Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish
 the men who fight with us.

33.d: त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ प्रतू॑र्तिष्व॒भि विश्वा॑ असि॒ स्पृधः॑ । अ॑शस्ति॒हा ज॑नि॒ता वि॑श्व॒तूर॑सि॒ त्वं तू॑र्य तरुष्य॒तः ।।
33.e:
Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might
 As sire and mother to their child.

33.d: अनु॑ ते॒ शुष्मं॑ तु॒रय॑न्तमीयतुः क्षो॒णी शिशुं॒ न मा॒तरा॑ । विश्वा॑स्ते॒ स्पृधः॑ श्नथयन्त म॒न्यवे॑ वृ॒त्रं यदि॑न्द्र॒ तूर्व॑सि ।।
33.e: The sacrifice obtains the Gods’ acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.

33.d: य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृड॒यन्तः॑ । आ वो॒ र्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्या॒दँहो॑श्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑त् ।।
33.e:
Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian
 aids around, propitious, ne’er beguiled.
 God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not
 the evil-wisher have us in his power.

33.d: अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वँ शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् । हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घशँ॑स ईशत ।।
33.e:
For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed
 by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices.
 Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for
 thy rapture of the sap of Soma.

33.d: प्र वी॑र॒या शुच॑यो दद्रिरे वामध्व॒र्युभि॒र्मधु॑मन्तः सु॒तासः॑ । वह॑ वायो नि॒युतो॑ या॒ह्यच्छा॒ पिबा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सो॒ मदा॑य ।।
33.e: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.

33.d: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑ ।।
33.e:
Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the
 birth-places of the two great Sages,
 With force of intellect unto the dwelling.

33.d: काव्य॑योरा॒जाने॑षु॒ क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य दुरो॒णे । रि॒शाद॑सा स॒धस्थ॒ आ ।।
33.e:
Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in
 the time of old. See, Vena.

33.d: दै॑व्यावध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑तँ॒ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञँ सम॑ञ्जाथे । तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ । अ॒यं वे॒नः ।।
33.e:
Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above,
 or was it, haply, under?
 There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action
 here and energy up yonder.

33.d: ति॑र॒श्चीनो॒ वित॑तो र॒श्मिरे॑षाम॒धः स्वि॑दा॒सी३दु॒परि॑ स्विदासी३त् । रे॑तो॒धा आ॑सन्महि॒मान॑ आसन्त्स्व॒धा अ॒वस्ता॒त्प्रय॑तिः प॒रस्ता॑त् ।।
33.e:
He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light,
 when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold.
 He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously
 inclined, that he may win us wealth.

33.d: आ रोद॑सी अपृण॒दा स्व॑र्म॒हज्जा॒तं यदे॑नम॒पसो॒ अधा॑रयन् । सो अ॑ध्व॒राय॒ परि॑ णीयते क॒विरत्यो॒ न वाज॑सातये॒ चनो॑हितः ।।
33.e:
Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of
 the foe,
 Delighting even in our hymn.

33.d: उ॒क्थेभि॑र्वृत्र॒हन्त॑मा॒ या म॑न्दा॒ना चि॒दा गि॒रा । आ॑ङ्गूषैरा॒विवा॑सतः ।।
33.e:
All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing,
 And be exceeding good to us.

33.d: उप॑ नः सू॒नवो॒ गिरः॑ शृ॒ण्वन्त्व॒मृत॑स्य॒ ये । सु॑मृडी॒का भ॑वन्तु नः ।।
33.e:
Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength
 stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon.
 They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their
 libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.

33.d: ब्रह्मा॑णि मे म॒तयः॒ शँ सु॒तासः॒ शुष्म॑ इयर्ति॒ प्रभृ॑तो मे॒ अद्रिः॑ । आ शा॑सते॒ प्रति॑ हर्यन्त्यु॒क्थेमा हरी॑ वहत॒स्ता नो॒ अच्छ॑ ।।
33.e:
Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among
 the Gods not one is found thine equal.
 None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what
 thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!

33.d: अनु॑त्त॒मा ते॑ मघव॒न्नकि॒र्नु न त्वावाँ॑ अस्ति दे॒वता॒ विदा॑नः । न जाय॑मानो॒ नश॑ते॒ न जा॒तो यानि॑ करि॒ष्या कृ॑णु॒हि प्र॑वृद्ध ।।
33.e:
In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence
 sprang the mighty God of splendid valour.
 Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom
 all who lend him aid are joyful.

33.d: तदिदा॑स॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यतो॑ ज॒ज्ञ उ॒ग्रस्त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो नि रि॑णाति॒ शत्रू॒ननु॒ यं विश्वे॒ मद॒न्त्यूमाः॑ ।।
33.e:
May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast
 abundant wealth.
 Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have
 sung them with their lauds to thee.

33.d: इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पुरूवसो॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्तु॒ या मम॑ । पा॑व॒कव॑र्णाः॒ शुच॑यो विप॒श्चितो॒ भि स्तोमै॑रनूषत ।।
33.e:
Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here
 belong.
 E’en over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that
 wealth brought nigh.

33.d: यस्या॒यं विश्व॒ आर्यो॒ दासः॑ शेवधि॒पा अ॒रिः । ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्ये रु॒शमे॒ परी॑रवि॒ तुभ्येत्सो अ॑ज्यते र॒यिः ।।
33.e:
He, with his might advanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath
 like an ocean spread himself.
 His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power
 where holy singers rule.
 84. Protect our habitation, Savitar, etc., as in verse 69.

33.d: अ॒यँ स॒हस्र॒मृषि॑भिः॒ सह॑स्कृतः समु॒द्र इ॑व पप्रथे । स॒त्यः सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा गृ॑णे॒ शवो॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ विप्र॒राज्ये॑ ।।
33.e:
Come, Vâyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that
 reaches heaven.
 Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth and dressed,
 this bright drink hath been offered thee.

33.d: अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वँ शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् । हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घशँ॑स ईशत ।।
33.e:
Indra and Vâyu, fair to see and swift to hear, we call to us,
 That in assembly all, yea, all the folk may be benevolent to
 us and free from malady.

33.d: आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं दि॑वि॒स्पृशं॒ वायो॑ या॒हि सु॒मन्म॑भिः । अ॒न्तः प॒वित्र॑ उ॒परि॑ श्रीणा॒नो॒ यँ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते ।।
33.e:
Yea, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of
 the Gods,
 Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna to share
 his sacrificial gifts.

33.d: इ॑न्द्रवा॒यू सु॑सं॒दृशा॑ सु॒हवे॒ह ह॑वामहे । यथा॑ नः॒ सर्व॒ इज्जनो॑ नमी॒वः सं॒गमे॑ सु॒मना॒ अस॑त् ।।
33.e:
Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of
 the mead.
 Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth!
 Injure us not, and come to us.

33.d: ऋध॑गि॒त्था स मर्त्यः॑ शश॒मे दे॒वता॑तये । यो नू॒नं मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒भिष्ट॑य आच॒क्रे ह॒व्यदा॑तये ।।
33.e:
May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may Sûnritâ the Goddess
 come,
 And Gods bring to our rite which gives the fivefold gift the
 Hero, lover of mankind.

33.d: आ या॑त॒मुप॑ भूषतं॒ मध्वः॑ पिबतमश्विना । दु॒ग्धं पयो॑ वृषणा जेन्यावसू॒ मा नो॑ मर्धिष्ट॒मा ग॑तम् ।।
33.e:
Within the Waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous
 wings, in heaven.
 To yellow-hued abundant wealth, object of many a man's
 desire, loud-neighing goes the tawny Steed.

33.d: प्रै॑तु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॒ प्र दे॒व्ये॑तु सू॒नृता॑ । अच्छा॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॑ प॒ङ्क्तिरा॑धसं दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं न॑यन्तु नः ।।
33.e:
Singing their praise with godlike hymn let us invoke each
 God for grace,
 Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

33.d: च॒न्द्रमा॑ अ॒प्स्व॒न्तरा सु॑प॒र्णो धा॑वते दि॒वि । र॒यिं पि॒शंगं॑ बहु॒लं पु॑रु॒स्पृहँ॒ हरि॑रेति॒ कनि॑क्रदत् ।।
33.e:
Agni Vaisvânara, set in heaven, with mighty splendour
 hath shone forth.
 Increasing in his power on earth, benevolent, he quells the
 darkness with his light.

33.d: दे॒वंदे॑वं॒ वो व॑से दे॒वंदे॑वम॒भिष्ट॑ये । दे॒वंदे॑वँ हुवेम॒ वाज॑सातये गृ॒णन्तो॑ दे॒व्या धि॒या ।।
33.e:
First, Indra Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those
 with feet.
 Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue,
 she hath gone downward thirty steps.

33.d: दि॒वि पृ॒ष्टो अ॑रोचता॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रो बृ॒हन् । क्ष्मया॑ वृधा॒न ओज॑सा॒ चनो॑हितो॒ ज्योति॑षा बाधते॒ तमः॑ ।।
33.e:
For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers
 all of gracious gifts.
 May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing
 ease and ample room.

33.d: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी अ॒पादि॒यं पूर्वागा॑त्प॒द्वती॑भ्यः । हि॒त्वी शिरो॑ जि॒ह्वया॒ वाव॑द॒च्चर॑त्त्रिँ॒शत्प॒दा न्य॑क्रमीत् ।।
33.e:
Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then
 in splendour came to us.
 Indra, refulgent with the Marut host! the Gods eagerly
 strove to win thy love.

33.d: दे॒वासो॒ हि ष्मा॒ मन॑वे॒ सम॑न्यवो॒ विश्वे॑ सा॒कँ सरा॑तयः । ते नो॑ अ॒द्य ते अ॑प॒रं तु॒चे तु नो॒ भव॑न्तु वरिवो॒विदः॑ ।।
33.e:
To Indra, to your mighty Chief, Maruts, sing forth a mighty
 prayer.
 Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, kill the fiend with hundred-knotted
 thunderbolt.

33.d: अपा॑धमद॒भिश॑स्तीरशस्ति॒हाथेन्द्रो॑ द्यु॒म्न्याभ॑वत् । दे॒वास्त॑ इन्द्र स॒ख्याय॑ येमिरे॒ बृह॑द्भानो॒ मरु॑द्गण ।।
33.e:
Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild
 rapture of this juice;
 And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their
 praises to his majesty.
 May these. Good Lord of wealth. He with his might.
 Stand up erect.

34.d: यज्जाग्र॑तो दू॒रमुदैति दैवं॒ तदु॑ सु॒प्तस्य॒ तथैवैति । दू॑रंग॒मं ज्योति॑षां॒ ज्योति॒रेकं॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
-FOURTH.

THAT which, divine, mounts far when man is waking, that
 which returns to him when he is sleeping,
 The lights’ one light that goeth to a distance, may that,
 my mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: येन॒ कर्मा॑ण्य॒पसो॑ मनी॒षिणो॑ य॒ज्ञे कृ॒ण्वन्ति॑ वि॒दथे॑षु॒ धीराः॑ । यद॑पू॒र्वं य॒क्षम॒न्तः प्र॒जानां॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
Whereby the wise and thoughtful in assemblies, active in
 sacrifice, perform their duties,
 The peerless spirit stored in living creatures, may that, my
 mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: यत्प्र॒ज्ञान॑मु॒त चेतो॒ धृति॑श्च॒ यज्ज्योति॑र॒न्तर॒मृतं॑ प्र॒जासु॑ । यस्मा॒न्न ऋ॒ते किं च॒न कर्म॑ क्रि॒यते॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
That which is wisdom, intellect, and firmness, immortal light
 which creatures have within them,
 That without which men do no single action, may that, my
 mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: येने॒दं भू॒तं भुव॑नं भवि॒ष्यत्परि॑गृहीतम॒मृते॑न॒ सर्व॑म् । येन॑ य॒ज्ञस्ता॒यते॑ स॒प्तहो॑ता॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
Whereby, immortal, all is comprehended, the world which is,
 and what shall be hereafter,
 Whereby spreads sacrifice with seven Hotars, may that, my
 mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: यस्मि॒न्नृचः॒ साम॒ यजूँ॑षि॒ यस्मि॒न्प्रति॑ष्ठिता रथना॒भावि॑वा॒राः । यस्मिँ॑श्चि॒त्तँ सर्व॒मोतं॑ प्र॒जानं॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
Wherein the Richas, Sâmans, Yajur-verses, like spokes within
 a car's nave, are included,
 And all the thought of creatures is inwoven, may that, my
 mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: सु॑षार॒थिरश्वा॑निव॒ यन्म॑नु॒ष्या॑न्नेनी॒यते॒ भीशु॑भिर्वा॒जिन॑ इव । हृ॒त्प्रति॑ष्ठं॒ यद॑जि॒रं जवि॑ष्ठं॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वसं॑कल्पमस्तु ।।
34.e:
Controlling men, as, with the reins that guide them, a skilful
 charioteer drives fleet-foot horses,
 Which dwells within the heart, agile, most rapid, may that,
 my mind, be moved by right intention.

34.d: पि॒तुं नु स्तो॑षं म॒हो ध॒र्माणं॒ तवि॑षीम् । यस्य॑ त्रि॒तो व्योज॑सा वृ॒त्रं विप॑र्वम॒र्दय॑त् ।।
34.e:
Now will I glorify great strength's upholder, Food,
 By whose invigorating might Trita rent Vritra limb from limb.

34.d: अन्विद॑नुमते॒ त्वं मन्या॑सै॒ शं च॑ नस्कृधि । क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य नो हिनु॒ प्र ण॒ आयूँ॑षि तारिषः ।।
34.e:
Do thou, in truth, Anumati, assent and grant us happiness.
 Urge us to strength and energy: prolong the days we have
 to live.

34.d: अनु॑ नो॒ द्यानु॑मतिर्य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ मन्यताम् । अ॒ग्निश्च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नो॒ भव॑तं दा॒शुषे॒ मयः॑ ।।
34.e:
Anumati this day approve our sacrifice among the Gods!
 Oblation-bearing Agni be, and thou, bliss to the worshipper!

34.d: सिनी॑वालि॒ पृथु॑ष्टुके॒ या दे॒वाना॒मसि॒ स्वसा॑ । जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः ।।
34.e:
O broad-tressed Sinîvâlî, thou who art the sister of the Gods,
 Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.

34.d: पञ्च॑ न॒द्यः॒ सर॑स्वती॒मपि॑ यन्ति॒ सस्रो॑तसः । सर॑स्वती॒ तु प॑ञ्च॒धा सो दे॒शे भ॑वत्स॒रित् ।।
34.e:
Five rivers flowing on their way speed onward to Sarasvatî,
 But then became Sarasvatî a fivefold river in the land.

34.d: त्वम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो अङ्गि॑रा॒ ऋषि॑र्दे॒वो दे॒वाना॑मभवः शि॒वः सखा॑ । तव॑ व्र॒ते क॒वयो॑ विद्म॒नाप॒सो जा॑यन्त म॒रुतो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयः ।।
34.e:
O Agni, thou the earliest Angiras, the Seer, hast, God thyself,
 become the Gods’ auspicious Friend.
 After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through
 wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.

34.d: त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ तवे॑ देव पा॒युभि॑र्म॒घोनो॑ रक्ष त॒न्व॑श्च वन्द्य । त्रा॒ता तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑ये॒ गवा॑म॒स्यनि॑मेषँ॒ रक्ष॑ण॒स्तव॑ व्र॒ते ।।
34.e:
Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy
 patrons with thy succours, and ourselves.
 Guard art thou of our seed and progeny and cows, incessantly
 protecting in thy holy law.

34.d: उ॑त्ता॒नाया॒मव॑ भरा चिकि॒त्वान्त्स॒द्यः प्रवी॑ता॒ वृष॑णं जजान । अ॑रु॒षस्तू॑पो॒ रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॒ इडा॑यास्पु॒त्रो व॒युने॑ जनिष्ट ।।
34.e:
Lay this with care on her who lies extended: straight, when
 impregned, hath she brought forth the Hero.
 With his bright pillar—radiant is his lustre—in our skilled
 task is born the Son of Idâ.

34.d: इडा॑यास्त्वा प॒दे व॒यं नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ । जात॑वेदो॒ नि धी॑म॒ह्यग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोढ॑वे ।।
34.e:
In Idâ's place, the centre of the earth, will we deposit thee,
 That, Agni Jâtavedas, thou mayst bear our offerings to the
 Gods.

34.d: प्र म॑न्महे शवसा॒नाय॑ शू॒षमा॑ङ्गू॒षं गिर्व॑णसे अङ्गिर॒स्वत् । सु॑वृ॒क्तिभि॑ स्तुव॒त ऋ॑ग्मि॒यायार्चा॑मा॒र्कं नरे॒ विश्रु॑ताय ।।
34.e:
Like Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth
 song, exceeding mighty.
 Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised
 with fair hymns by the singer.

34.d: प्र वो॑ म॒हे महि॒ नमो॑ भरध्वमाङ्गू॒ष्यँ॑ शवसा॒नाय॒ साम॑ । येना॑ नः॒ पूर्वे॑ पि॒तरः॑ पद॒ज्ञा अर्च॑न्तो॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गा अवि॑न्दन् ।।
34.e:
Unto the Great One bring great adoration, a chant of praise
 to him the very potent,
 Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises, and
 knowing well the places, found the cattle.

34.d: इ॒च्छन्ति॑ त्वा सो॒म्यासः॒ सखा॑यः सु॒न्वन्ति॒ सोमं॒ दध॑ति॒ प्रयाँ॑सि । तिति॑क्षन्ते अ॒भिश॑स्तिं॒ जना॑ना॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वदा कश्च॒न हि प्र॑के॒तः ।।
34.e:
The friends who offer Soma long to find thee: they pour
 forth Soma and present their viands.
 They bear, Unmoved, the cursing of the people, for all our
 wisdom comes from thee, O Indra.

34.d: न ते॑ दू॒रे प॑र॒मा चि॒द्रजाँ॑स्य॒स्या तु प्र या॑हि हरिवो॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । स्थि॒राय॒ वृष्णे॒ सव॑ना कृ॒तेमा यु॒क्ता ग्रावा॑णः समिधा॒ने अग्नौ ।।
34.e:
Not far for thee are mid-air's loftiest regions: start hither,
 Lord of Bays, with both Bay Horses.
 Pressed for the Firm and Strong are these libations. The
 pressing-stones are set, the fire is kindled.

34.d: अषा॑ढं यु॒त्सु पृत॑नासु॒ पप्रिँ॑ स्व॒र्षाम॒प्सां वृ॒जन॑स्य गो॒पाम् । भ॑रेषु॒जाँ सु॑क्षि॒तिँ सु॒श्रव॑सं॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वामनु॑ मदेम सोम ।।
34.e:
Invincible in fight, saviour in battles, guard of our camp,
 winner of light and water,
 Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in
 thee may we rejoice, O Soma.

34.d: सोमो॑ धे॒नुँ सोमो॒ अर्व॑न्तमा॒शुँ सोमो॑ वी॒रं क॑र्म॒ण्यं॑ ददाति । सा॑द॒न्यं॑ विद॒थ्यँ॑ स॒भेयं॑ पितृ॒श्रव॑णं॒ यो ददा॑शदस्मै ।।
34.e:
To him who worships Soma gives a milch cow, a fleet steed,
 and a man of active knowledge,
 Skilled in home duties, competent in council, meet for the
 court, the glory of his father.

34.d: त्वमि॒मा ओष॑धीः सोम॒ विश्वा॒स्त्वम॒पो अ॑जनय॒स्त्वं गाः । त्वमा त॑तन्थो॒र्व॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ त्वं ज्योति॑षा॒ वि तमो॑ ववर्थ ।।
34.e:
These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all
 these, O Soma, thou hast generated.
 The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the
 light thou hast dispelled the darkness.

34.d: दे॒वेन॑ नो॒ मन॑सा देव सोम रा॒यो भा॒गँ स॑हसावन्न॒भि यु॑ध्य । मा त्वा त॑न॒दीशि॑षे वी॒र्य॑स्यो॒भये॑भ्यः॒ प्र चि॑कित्सा॒ गवि॑ष्टौ ।।
34.e:
Do thou, God Soma, with thy God-like spirit, victorious,
 win for us a share of riches.
 Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide
 for these and those in fight for cattle.

34.d: अष्टौ॒ व्य॑ख्यत्क॒कुभः॑ पृथि॒व्यास्त्री धन्व॒ योज॑ना स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न् । हि॑रण्या॒क्षः स॑वि॒ता दे॒व आगा॒द्दध॒द्रत्ना॑ दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि ।।
34.e:
The earth's eight points his brightness hath illumined, three
 desert regions, and the Seven Rivers.

God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving choice
 treasures to the man who worships.

34.d: हिर॑ण्यपाणिः सवि॒ता विच॑र्षणिरु॒भे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरी॑यते । अपामी॑वां॒ बाध॑ते॒ वेति॒ सूर्य॑म॒भि कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ द्यामृ॑णोति ।।
34.e:
Savitar, golden-handed, swiftly moving, goes on his way
 between the earth and heaven,
 Drives away sickness, bids the Sun approach us, and spreads
 the bright sky through the darksome region.

34.d: हिर॑ण्यहस्तो॒ असु॑रः सुनी॒थः सु॑मृडी॒कः स्ववा॑ यात्व॒र्वाङ् । अ॑प॒सेध॑न्र॒क्षसो॑ यातु॒धाना॒नस्था॑द्दे॒वः प्र॑तिदो॒षं गृ॑णा॒नः ।।
34.e:
May, he, gold-handed Asura, kind leader, come hitherward
 to us with help and favour.
 Driving off Râkshasas and Yâtudhânas, the God is present,
 praised in hymns at evening.

34.d: ये ते॒ पन्थाः॑ सवितः पू॒र्व्यासो॑ रे॒णवः॒ सुकृ॑ता अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे । तेभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभी॒ रक्षा॑ च नो॒ अधि॑ च ब्रूहि देव ।।
34.e:
O Savitar, thine ancient dustless pathways are well established
 in the air's mid-region.
 O God, come by those paths so fair to travel: preserve thou
 us from harm this day and bless us.

34.d: उ॒भा पि॑बतमश्विनो॒भा नः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम् । अ॑विद्रि॒याभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ ।।
34.e:
Drink our libations, Asvins twain, grant us protection, both
 of you,
 With aids which none may interrupt.

34.d: अप्न॑स्वतीमश्विना॒ वाच॑म॒स्मे कृ॒तं नो॑ दस्रा॒ वृष॑णा मनी॒षाम् । अ॑द्यू॒त्ये व॑से॒ नि ह्व॑ये वां वृ॒धे च॑ नो भवतं॒ वाज॑सातौ ।।
34.e:
Make ye our speech effectual, O Asvins, and this our hymn,
 ye mighty Wonder-workers.
 In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us
 also on the field of battle.

34.d: द्युभि॑र॒क्तुभिः॒ परि॑ पातम॒स्मानरि॑ष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः । तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑तिः॒ सिन्धुः॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः॑ ।।
34.e:
With undiminished blessings, O ye Asvins, through days and
 nights on every side protect us.
 This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi
 and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

34.d: आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च । हि॑र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न् ।।
34.e: Throughout the dusky firmament, etc., as in XXXIII. 43.

34.d: आ रा॑त्रि॒ पर्थि॑वँ॒ रजः॑ पि॒तुर॑प्रायि॒ धम॑भिः । दि॒वः सदाँ॑सि बृह॒ती वि ति॑ष्ठस॒ आ त्वे॒षं व॑र्तते॒ तमः॑ ।।
34.e:
Night! the terrestrial realm hath been filled with the
 Father's power and might.
 Thou spreadest thee on high unto the seats of heaven: terrific
 darkness cometh nigh.

34.d: उष॒स्तच्चि॒त्रमा भ॑रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ वाजिनीवति । येन॑ तो॒कं च॒ तन॑यं च॒ धाम॑हे ।।
34.e:
O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us that
 wondrous gift
 Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.

34.d: प्रा॒तर॒ग्निं प्रा॒तरिन्द्रँ॑ हवामहे प्रा॒तर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा प्रा॒तर॒श्विना॑ । प्रा॒तर्भगं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॑ प्रा॒तः सोम॑मु॒त रु॒द्रँ हु॑वेम ।।
34.e:
Agni at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna
 and Mitra and the Asvins twain,
 Bhaga at dawn, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn,
 Rudra may we invoke at dawn.

34.d: प्रा॑त॒र्जितं॒ भग॑मु॒ग्रँ हु॑वेम व॒यं पु॒त्रमदि॑ते॒र्यो वि॑ध॒र्ता । आ॒ध्रश्चि॒द्यं मन्य॑मानस्तु॒रश्चि॒द्राजा॑ चि॒द्यं भगं॑ भ॒क्षीत्याह॑ ।।
34.e:
May we invoke strong early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of
 Aditi, the great Arranger,
 Thinking of whom the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the
 King says, Let me share in Bhaga.

34.d: भग॒ प्रणे॑त॒र्भग॒ सत्य॑राधो॒ भगे॒मां धिय॒मुद॑वा॒ दद॑न्नः । भग॒ प्र णो॑ जनय॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॒र्भग॒ प्र नृभि॑र्नृ॒वन्तः॑ स्याम ।।
34.e:
Bhaga our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, favour this
 prayer and give us wealth, O Bhaga.
 Bhaga, increase our store of kine and horses: Bhaga, may
 we be rich in men and heroes.

34.d: उ॒तेदानीं॒ भग॑वन्तः स्यामो॒त प्र॑पि॒त्व उ॒त मध्ये॒ अह्ना॑म् । उ॒तोदि॑ता मघव॒न्सूर्य॑स्य व॒यं दे॒वानाँ॑ सुमतौ स्याम ।।
34.e:
So may felicity be ours at present, and when the day
 approaches, and at noontide;
 And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy in
 the Deities’ loving-kindness.

34.d: भग॑ ए॒व भग॑वाँ अस्तु देवा॒स्तेन॑ व॒यं भग॑वन्तः स्याम । तं त्वा॑ भग॒ सर्व॒ इज्जो॑हवीति॒ स नो॑ भग पुरए॒ता भ॑वे॒ह ।।
34.e:
May Bhaga verily he Bliss-bestower, and through him,
 Gods! may happiness attend us.
 As such, O Bhaga, all with might invoke thee: as such be
 thou our Champion here, O Bhaga.

34.d: सम॑ध्व॒रायो॒षसो॑ नमन्त दधि॒क्रावे॑व॒ शुच॑ये प॒दाय॑ । अ॑र्वाची॒नं व॑सु॒विदं॒ भगं॑ नो॒ रथ॑मि॒वाश्वा॑ वा॒जिन॒ आ व॑हन्तु ।।
34.e:
To this our worship may the Dawns incline them, and come
 to the pure place like Dadhikrâvan.
 As strong steeds draw a chariot shay they bring us hitherward
 Bhaga who discovers treasure.

34.d: अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्न उ॒षासो॑ वी॒रव॑तीः॒ सद॑मुच्छन्तु भ॒द्राः । घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना वि॒श्वतः॒ प्रपी॑ता यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ।।
34.e:
May friendly Mornings dawn on us for ever, with wealth of
 kine, of horses, and of heroes,
 Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve
 us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

34.d: पूष॒न्तव॑ व्र॒ते व॒यं न रि॑ष्येम॒ कदा॑ च॒न । स्तो॒तार॑स्त इ॒ह स्म॑सि ।।
34.e:
Secure in thy protecting care, O Pûshan, never may we fail:
 We here are singers of thy praise.

34.d: प॒थस्॑पथः॒ परि॑पतिं वच॒स्या कामे॑न कृ॒तो अ॒भ्या॑नड॒र्कम् । स नो॑ रासच्छु॒रुध॑श्च॒न्द्राग्रा॒ धियं॑धियँ सीषधाति॒ प्र पू॒षा ।।
34.e:
I praise with eloquence hire who guards all pathways. He,
 when his love impelled him, went to Arka.
 May he vouchsafe us gear with gold to grace it: may Pûshan
 make each prayer of ours effective.

34.d: त्रीणि॑ प॒दा वि च॑क्रमे॒ विष्णु॑र्गो॒पा अदा॑भ्यः । अतो॒ धर्मा॑णि धा॒रय॑न् ।।
34.e:
Vishnu the undeceivable Protector strode three steps, thenceforth
 Establishing his high decrees.

34.d: तद्विप्रा॑सो विप॒न्यवो॑ जागृ॒वाँसः॒ समि॑न्धते । विष्णो॒र्यत्प॑र॒मं प॒दम् ।।
34.e:
This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers ever vigilant.
 Lovers of holy song, light up.

34.d: घृ॒तव॑ती॒ भुव॑नानामभि॒श्रियो॒र्वी पृ॒थ्वी म॑धु॒दुघे॑ सु॒पेश॑सा । द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा॒ विष्क॑भिते अ॒जरे॒ भूरि॑रेतसा ।।
34.e:
Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide,
 spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form,
 The Heaven and the Earth by Varuna's decree, unwasting,
 rich in seed, stand parted each from each.

34.d: ये नः॑ स॒पत्ना॒ अप॒ ते भ॑वन्त्विन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॒मव॑ बाधामहे॒ तान् । वस॑वो रु॒द्रा आ॑दि॒त्या उ॑परि॒स्पृशं॑ मो॒ग्रं चेत्ता॑रमधिरा॒जम॑क्रन् ।।
34.e:
Let those who are our foemen stand afar from us: with
 Indra and with Agni we will drive them off.
 Vasus, Âdityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me preëminent,
 mighty, thinker, sovran lord.

34.d: आ ना॑सत्या त्रि॒भिरे॑कादशैरि॒ह दे॒वेभि॑र्यातं मधु॒पेय॑मश्विना । प्रायु॒स्तारि॑ष्टं॒ नी रपाँ॑सि मृक्षतँ॒ सेध॑तं॒ द्वेषो॒ भव॑तँ सचा॒भुवा॑ ।।
34.e:
Come, O Nâsatyas, with the thrice eleven Gods: come,
 O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath.
 Prolong our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off
 our enemies; be with us evermore.

34.d: ए॒ष व॒ स्तोमो॑ मरुत इ॒यं गीर्मा॑न्दा॒र्यस्य॑ मा॒न्यस्य॑ का॒रोः । एषा या॑सीष्ट त॒न्वे॑ व॒यां वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम् ।।
34.e:
May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung
 by the poet, Mâna's son, Mândârya,

Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we
 find strengthening food in full abundance.

34.d: स॒हस्तो॑माः स॒हच्छ॑न्दस आ॒वृतः॑ स॒हप्र॑मा॒ ऋष॑यः स॒प्त दै॑व्याः । पूर्वे॑षां॒ पन्था॑मनु॒दृश्य॒ धीरा॑ अ॒न्वाले॑भिरे र॒थ्यो॒ न र॒श्मीन् ।।
34.e:
They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and
 rules, were the Seven godlike Rishis.
 Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up
 the reins like chariot-drivers.

34.d: आ॑यु॒ष्यं॑ वर्च॒स्यँ॑ रा॒यस्पोषऔद्भिदम् । इ॒दँ हिर॑ण्यं॒ वर्च॑स्वज्जैत्रा॒या वि॑शतादु॒ माम् ।।
34.e:
Bestowing splendour, length of life, increase of wealth, and
 conquering power,
 This brightly shining gold shall be attached to me for victory.

34.d: न तद्रक्षाँ॑सि॒ न पि॑शा॒चास्त॑रन्ति दे॒वाना॒मोजः॑ प्रथम॒जँ ह्ये॒तत् । यो बि॒भर्ति॑ दाक्षाय॒णँ हिर॑ण्यँ॒ स दे॒वेषु॑ कृणुते दी॒र्घमायुः॒ स म॑नु॒ष्ये॑षु कृणुते दी॒र्घमायुः॑ ।।
34.e:
This gold no demons injure, no Pisâchas; for this is might
 of Gods, their primal offspring.
 Whoever wears the gold of Daksha's children lives a long life
 among the Gods, lives a long life among mankind.

34.d: यदाब॑ध्नन्दाक्षाय॒णा हिर॑ण्यँ श॒तानी॑काय सुमन॒स्यमा॑नाः । त न्मआ ब॑ध्नामि श॒तशा॑रदा॒यायु॑ष्मान्ज॒रद॑ष्टि॒र्यथास॑म् ।।
34.e:
This ornament of gold which Daksha's children bound, with
 benevolent thoughts, on Satânîka,
 I bind on me for life through hundred autumns, that I may
 live till ripe old age o’ertakes me.

34.d: उ॒त नो हि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यः॑ शृणोत्व॒ज एक॑पात्पृथि॒वी स॑मु॒द्रः । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा ऋ॑ता॒वृधो॑ हुवा॒ना स्तु॒ता मन्त्राः॑ कविश॒स्ता अ॑वन्तु ।।
34.e:
Let Ahibudhnya also hear our calling, and Aja-Ekapâd and
 Earth and Ocean.

All Gods Law-strengtheners, invoked and lauded, and Texts
 recited by the sages, help us!

34.d: इ॒मा गिर॑ आदि॒त्येभ्यो॑ घृ॒तस्नूः॑ स॒नाद्राज॑भ्यो जु॒ह्वा॑ जुहोमि । शृ॒णोतु॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा भगो॑ नस्तुविजा॒तो वरु॑णो॒ दक्षो॒ अँशः॑ ।।
34.e:
These hymns that drop down fatness, with the ladle I ever
 offer to the Kings Âdityas.
 May Mitra, Aryaman, and Bhaga hear us, the mighty Varuna,
 Daksha, and Amsa.

34.d: स॒प्त ऋष॑यः॒ प्रति॑हिताः॒ शरी॑रे स॒प्त र॑क्षन्ति॒ सद॒मप्र॑मादम् । स॒प्तापः॒ स्वप॑तो लो॒कमी॑यु॒स्तत्र॑ जागृतो॒ अस्व॑प्नजौ सत्र॒सदौ॑ च देवौ ।।
34.e:
Seven Rishis are established in the body: seven guard it
 evermore with care unceasing.
 Seven waters seek the world of him who lies asleep: two
 sleepless Gods are feast-fellows of him who wakes.

34.d: उत्ति॑ष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देव॒यन्त॑स्त्वेमहे । उप॒ प्र य॑न्तु म॒रुतः॑ सु॒दान॑व॒ इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒शूर्भ॑वा॒ सचा॑ ।।
34.e:
O Brahmanaspati, arise. God-fearing men, we pray to thee.
 May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra,
 be thou most swift with them.

34.d: प्र नू॒नं ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्मन्त्रं॑ वदत्यु॒क्थ्य॑म् । यस्मि॒न्निन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा दे॒वा ओकाँ॑सि चक्रि॒रे ।।
34.e:
Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn
 of praise.
 Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods have
 made their dwelling-place.

34.d: ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ त्वम॒स्य य॒न्ता सू॒क्तस्य॑ बोधि॒ तन॑यं च जिन्व । विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीराः॑ । य इ॒मा विश्वा॑ । वि॒श्वक॑र्मा । यो नः॑ पि॒ता । अन्न॑प॒ते न्न॑स्य नो देहि ।।
34.e:
O Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn, and
 prosper thou our children.
 All that the Gods regard with love is blessèd. Loud may
 we speak, with brave sons, in assembly.
 He who sate down. Mighty in mind. Father who made us.
 A share of good, O Lord of Food.

35.d: अपे॒तो य॑न्तु प॒णयो सु॑म्ना देवपी॒यवः॑ । अ॒स्य लो॒कः सु॒ताव॑तः । द्युभि॒रहो॑भिर॒क्तुभि॒र्व्य॑क्तं य॒मो द॑दात्वव॒सान॑मस्मै ।।
35.e:
-FIFTH.

BEGONE the Panis, hence away, rebellious, scorners of the
 Gods!
 The place is his who poured the juice.

35.d: स॑वि॒ता ते॒ शरी॑रेभ्यः पृथि॒व्यां लो॒कमि॑च्छतु । तस्मै॑ युज्यन्तामु॒स्रियाः॑ ।।
35.e:
Let Savitar approve a spot upon the earth for thy remains:
 And let the bulls be yoked for it.

35.d: वा॒युः पु॑नातु । स॑वि॒ता पु॑नातु । अ॒ग्नेर्भ्राज॑सा । सूर्य॑स्य॒ वर्च॑सा । वि मु॑च्यन्तामु॒स्रियाः॑ ।।
35.e:
Let Vâyu purify. Let Savitar purify. With Agni's glitter.
 With Savitar's lustre. Let the bulls be unyoked.

35.d: अ॑श्व॒त्थे वो॑ नि॒षद॑नं प॒र्णे वो॑ वस॒तिष्कृ॒ता । गो॒भाज॒ इत्किला॑सथ॒ यत्स॒नव॑थ॒ पूरु॑षम् ।।
35.e:
The Holy Fig Tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna
 Tree:
 Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

35.d: स॑वि॒ता ते॒ शरी॑राणि मा॒तुरु॒पस्थ॒ आ व॑पतु । तस्मै॑ पृथिवि॒ शं भ॑व ।।
35.e:
Let Savitar lay down thy bones committed to the Mother's
 lap.
 Be pleasant to this man, O Earth.

35.d: प्र॒जाप॑तौ त्वा दे॒वता॑या॒मुपो॑दके लो॒के नि द॑धाम्यसौ । अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ।।
35.e:
Here in the God Prajâpati, near water, Man, I lay thee down:
 May his light drive mishap from us.

35.d: परं॑ मृत्यो॒ अनु॒ परे॑हि॒ पन्थां॒ यस्ते॑ अ॒न्य इत॑रो देव॒याना॑त् । चक्षु॑ष्मते शृण्व॒ते ते॑ ब्रवीमि॒ मा नः॑ प्र॒जाँ री॑रिषो॒ मोत वी॒रान् ।।
35.e:
Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from
 that which Gods are wont to travel.
 To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our
 offspring, injure not our heroes.

35.d: शं वातः॒ शँ हि ते॒ घृणिः॒ शं ते॑ भव॒न्त्विष्ट॑काः । शं ते॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नयः॒ पार्थि॑वासो॒ मा त्वा॒भि शू॑शुचन् ।।
35.e:
Pleasant to thee be wind and sun, and pleasant be the bricks
 to thee.
 Pleasant to thee be the terrestrial fires: let them not scorch
 thee in their flames.

35.d: कल्प॑न्तां ते॒ दिश॒स्तुभ्य॒मापः॑ शि॒वत॑मा॒स्तुभ्यं॑ भवन्तु॒ सिन्ध॑वः । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षँ शि॒वं तुभ्यं॒ कल्प॑न्तां ते॒ दिशः॒ सर्वाः॑ ।।
35.e:
Prosper for thee the regions and the waters, and let the seas
 for thee be most propitious.
 Auspicious unto thee be Air. Prosper all Quarters well for
 thee!

35.d: अश्म॑न्वती रीयते॒ सँ र॑भध्व॒मुत्ति॑ष्ठत॒ प्र त॑रता॒ सखा॑यः । अत्र॑ जही॒मो शि॑वा॒ ये अस॑ञ्छिवान्व॒यमुत्त॑रेमा॒भि वाजा॑न् ।।
35.e:
On flows the stony flood: hold fast each other, keep yourselves
 up, my friends, and pass the river.
 Here let us leave the powers that brought no profit, and
 cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.

35.d: अपा॒घमप॒ किल्वि॑ष॒मप॑ कृ॒त्यामपो॒ रपः॑ । अपा॑मार्ग॒ त्वम॒स्मदप॑ दुः॒ष्वप्न्यँ॑ सुव ।।
35.e:
Drive away evil, drive away fault, sorcery, and guiltiness.
 Do thou, O Apâmârga, drive the evil dream away from us.

35.d: सु॑मित्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ यो॒ स्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ।।
35.e:
To us let waters and the plants be friendly, to him who
 hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

35.d: अ॑न॒ड्वाह॒मा र॑भामहे सौरभेयँ स्व॒स्तये॑ । स न॒ इन्द्र॑ इव दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वह्निः॑ सं॒तर॑णो भव ।।
35.e:
For our prosperity we touch the ox the son of Surabhi.
 Be bearer and deliverer to us as Indra to the Gods.

35.d: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वः॒ पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ।।
35.e: Looking upon the loftiest light, etc., as in XX. 21.

35.d: इ॒मं जी॒वेभ्यः॑ परि॒धिं द॑धामि मैषां॒ नु गा॒दप॑रो॒ अर्थ॑मे॒तम् । श॒तं जी॑वन्तु श॒रदः॑ पुरू॒चीर॒न्तर्मृ॒त्युं द॑धतां॒ पर्व॑तेन ।।
35.e:
Here I erect this rampart for the living: let none of these,
 none other, reach this limit.
 May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may
 they bury Death beneath this mountain.

35.d: अग्न॒ आयूँ॑षि पवस्व॒ आ सु॒वोर्ज॒मिषं॑ च नः । आ॒रे बा॑धस्व दु॒च्छुना॑म् ।।
35.e: Agni, thou pourest life, etc., as in XIX. 38.

35.d: आयु॑ष्मानग्ने ह॒विषा॑ वृधा॒नो घृ॒तप्र्स॑तीको घृ॒तयो॑निरेधि । घृ॒तं पी॒त्वा मधु॒ चारु॒ गव्यं॑ पि॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रम॒भि र॑क्षतादि॒मान्त्स्वाहा॑ ।।
35.e:
Waxing with sacrifice live long, O Agni, with butter on thy
 face and homed in fatness.
 When thou hast drunk the cows’ fair savoury butter, guard,
 as a father guards his son, these people.

35.d: परी॒मे गाम॑नेषत॒ पर्य॒ग्निम॑हृषत । दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत॒ श्रवः॒ क इ॒माँ आ द॑धर्षति ।।
35.e:
These men have led about the ox, have duly carried Agni
 round,
 And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them
 with success?

35.d: क्र॒व्याद॑म॒ग्निं प्र हि॑णोमि दू॒रं य॑म॒राज्यं॑ गच्छतु रिप्रवा॒हः । इहै॒वायमित॑रो जा॒तवे॑दा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन् ।।
35.e:
I drive Corpse-eating Agni to a distance: sin-laden let him
 go to Yama's kingdom.
 Here let this other, Jâtavedas, carry oblation to the Deities,
 foreknowing.

35.d: वह॑ व॒पां जा॑तवेदः पि॒तृभ्यो॒ यत्रै॑ना॒न्वेत्थ॒ निहि॑तान्परा॒के । मेद॑सः कु॒ल्या उप॒ तान्त्स्र॑वन्तु स॒त्या ए॑षामा॒शिषः॒ सं न॑मन्ताँ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
35.e:
Carry the fat to Fathers, Jâtavedas, where, far away, thou
 knowest, them established.
 Let rivulets of marrow flow to meet them, and let their
 truthful wishes be accomplished. All-hail!

35.d: स्यो॒ना पृ॑थिवि नो भवानृक्ष॒रा नि॒वेश॑नी । यच्छा॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथाः॑ । अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ।।
35.e:
Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, without a thorn, our
 resting-place.
 Vouchsafe us shelter reaching far. May thy light drive
 mishap from us.

35.d: अ॒स्मात्त्वमधि॑ जा॒तो॑ सि॒ त्वद॒यं जा॑यतां॒ पुनः॑ । असौ स्व॒र्गाय॑ लो॒काय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।

36.d: ऋचं॒ वाचं॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ मनो॒ यजुः॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ साम॑ प्रा॒णं प्र प॑द्ये॒ चक्षुः॒ श्रोत्रं॒ प्र प॑द्ये । वागोजः॑ सहौजो॒ मयि॑ प्राणापानौ ।।
36.e:
-SIXTH.

REFUGE I take in Speech as Rich: refuge in Mind as
 Yajus-text; refuge in Breath as Sâma-chant; refuge in
 Hearing and in Sight.
 Speech-energy endowed with strength, inbreath and
 outbreath are in me.

36.d: यन्मे॑ छि॒द्रं चक्षु॑षो॒ हृद॑यस्य॒ मन॑सो॒ वाति॑तृणं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्मे॒ तद्द॑धातु । शं नो॑ भवतु॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पतिः॑ ।।
36.e:
Whatever deeply-sunk defect I have of eye, or mind, or
 heart, that way Brihaspati amend!
 Gracious to us be he, Protector of the world.

36.d: भूर्भुवः॒ स्वः॑ । तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दय॑त् ।।
36.e:
Earth! Ether! Heaven! May we attain that excellent, etc.,
 as in III. 33.
 With what help will he come to us etc., as in XXVII. 39.

36.d: कया॑ नश्चि॒त्र आ भु॑वदू॒ती स॒दावृ॑धः॒ सखा॑ । कया॒ शचि॑ष्ठया वृ॒ता ।।
36.e: What genuine, etc., as in XXVII. 40.

36.d: कस्त्वा॑ स॒त्यो मदा॑नां॒ मँहि॑ष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः । दृ॒ढा चि॑दा॒रुजे॒ वसु॑ ।।
36.e: Do thou who art, etc., as in XXVII. 41.

36.d: अ॒भी षु णः॒ सखी॑नामवि॒ता ज॑रितॄ॒णाम् । श॒तं भ॑वास्यू॒तये॑ ।।
36.e:
O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what
 succour bring
 Riches to those who worship thee?

36.d: कया॒ त्वम्न॑ ऊ॒त्याभि प्र म॑न्दसे वृषन् । क॒या स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ।।
36.e:
Indra is king of all that is: may weal attend our bipeds and
 our quadrupeds.

36.d: इन्द्रो॒ विश्व॑स्य राजति । शं नो॑ अस्तु द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे ।।
36.e:
Gracious he Mitra unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman;
 Indra, Brihaspati be kind, and Vishnu of the mighty stride.

36.d: शं नो॑ मि॒त्रँ शं वरु॑णः॒ शं नो॑ भवत्वर्य॒मा । शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पतिः॒ शं नो॒ विष्णु॑रुरुक्र॒मः ।।
36.e:
Pleasantly blow the wind for us, may Sûrya warm us
 pleasantly.
 Pleasantly, with a roar, the God Parjanya send the rain on us.

36.d: शं नो॒ वातः॑ पवताँ॒ शं न॑स्तपतु॒ सूर्यः॑ । शं नः॒ कनि॑क्रदद्दे॒वः प॒र्जन्यो॑ अ॒भि व॑र्षतु ।।
36.e:
May days pass pleasantly for us, may nights draw near
 delightfully.
 Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and
 Varuna who taste oblations.
 Indra and Pûshan be our help in battle, Indra and Soma
 give health, strength, and comfort.

36.d: अहा॑नि॒ शं भव॑न्तु नः॒ शँ रात्रीः॒ प्रति॑ धीयताम् । शं न॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी भ॑वता॒मवो॑भिः॒ शं न॒ इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा रा॒तह॑व्या । शं न॑ इन्द्रापू॒षणा॒ वाज॑सातौ॒ शमिन्द्रा॒सोमा॑ सुवि॒ताय॒ शं योः ।।
36.e:
May the celestial Waters, our helpers, be sweet for us to drink,
 And flow with health and strength to us.

36.d: शं नो॑ दे॒वीर॒भिष्ट॑य॒ आपो॑ भवन्तु पी॒तये॑ । शं योर॒भि स्र॑वन्तु नः ।।
36.e: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, etc., as in XXXV. 21.

36.d: स्यो॒ना पृ॑थिवि नो भवानृक्ष॒रा नि॒वेश॑नी । यच्छा॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथाः॑ ।।
36.e: Ye, Waters, are, etc., as in XL 50.

36.d: आपो॒ हि ष्ठा म॑यो॒भुव॒स्ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से ।।
36.e: Give us a portion, etc., as in XI. 51.

36.d: यो वः॑ शि॒वत॑मो॒ रस॒स्तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह नः॑ । उ॑श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तरः॑ ।।
36.e: To you we gladly come, etc., as in XI. 52,

36.d: तस्मा॒ अरं॑ गमाम वो॒ यस्य॒ क्षया॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ । आपो॑ ज॒नय॑था च नः ।।
36.e:
Sky alleviation, Air alleviation, Earth alleviation, Plants
 alleviation,
 Trees alleviation, All-Gods alleviation, Brahma alleviation,
 Universe alleviation, just Alleviation alleviation—may
 that alleviation come to me!

36.d: द्यौः॒ शान्ति॑र॒न्तरि॑क्षँ॒ शान्तिः॑ पृथि॒वी शान्ति॒रापः॒ शान्ति॒रोष॑धयः॒ शान्तिः॑ । वन॒स्पत॑यः॒ शान्ति॒र्विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः शान्ति॒र्ब्रह्म॒ शान्तिः॒ सर्वँ॒ शान्तिः॒ शान्ति॑रे॒व शान्तिः॒ सा मा॒ शान्ति॑रेधि ।।
36.e:
Caldron, strengthen me. May all beings regard me with the
 eye of a friend. May I regard all beings with the eye of
 a friend.
 With the eye of a friend do we regard one another.

36.d: दृते॒ दृँह॑ मा मि॒त्रस्य॑ मा॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ सर्वा॑णि भू॒तानि॒ समी॑क्षन्ताम् । मि॒त्रस्या॒हं चक्षु॑षा॒ सर्वा॑णि भू॒तानि॒ समी॑क्षे । मि॒त्रस्य॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ समी॑क्षामहे ।।
36.e:
Do thou, O Caldron, strengthen me. Long may I live to
 look on thee. Long may I live to look on thee.

36.d: दृते॒ दृँह॑ मा । ज्योक्ते॑ सं॒दृशि॑ जीव्यासं॒ ज्योक्ते॑ सं॒दृशि॑ जीव्यासम् ।।
36.e: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow, etc., as in XXII. 11.

36.d: नम॑स्ते॒ हर॑से शो॒चिषे॒ नम॑स्ते अस्त्व॒र्चिषे॑ । अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
36.e:
Homage to thee the lightning flash, homage to thee the
 thunder's roar!
 Homage, O Bounteous Lord, to thee whereas thou fain
 wouldst win to heaven!

36.d: नम॑स्ते अस्तु वि॒द्युते॒ नम॑स्ते स्तनयि॒त्नवे॑ । नम॑स्ते भगवन्नस्तु॒ यतः॒ स्वः॑ स॒मीह॑से ।।
36.e:
From whatsoever trouble thou desirest, give us safety thence.
 Give to our children happiness and to our beasts security.

36.d: यतो॑यतः स॒मीह॑से॒ ततो॑ नो॒ अभ॑यं कुरु । शं नः॑ कुरु प्र॒जाभ्यो भ॑यं नः प॒शुभ्यः॑ ।।
36.e: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly, etc., as in VI. 23.

36.d: सु॑मित्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु+ दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ यो॒ स्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ।।
36.e:
Through hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye,
 God-appointed, rise,
 A hundred autumns may we live.
 Through hundred autumns may we hear; through hundred
 autumns clearly speak: through hundred autumns live
 content; a hundred autumns, yea, beyond a hundred
 autumns may we see.

37.d: दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वे॒ श्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ नारि॑रसि ।।
37.e:
-SEVENTH.

By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, etc. Spade art thou.
 Woman art thou, etc., as in XI. 9, 10.

37.d: यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चितः॑ । वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुतिः॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
37.e: The priests of him the lofty Priest, etc., as in V. 14.

37.d: देवी॑ द्यावापृथिवी म॒खस्य॑ वाम॒द्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
O Heaven and Earth divine, may I duly prepare for you
 this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where
 the Gods sacrificed.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

37.d: देव्यो॑ वम्र्यो भू॒तस्य॑ प्रथम॒जा म॒खस्य॑ वो॒ द्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Ye who were born the earliest of creation, Ants divine, may
 I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on
 the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

37.d: इय॒त्यग्रे॑ आसीन्म॒खस्य॑ ते॒ द्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Only so large was it at first. Duly may I prepare for you
 this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the
 Gods sacrificed.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

37.d: इन्द्रस्यौज स्थ म॒खस्य॑ वो॒ द्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Indra's effective might are ye. Duly may I prepare for you
 this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the
 Gods sacrificed.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha
 thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee
 for the head of Makha!

37.d: प्रै॑तु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॒ प्र दे॒व्ये॑तु सू॒नृता॑ । अच्छा॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॑ प॒ङ्क्तिरा॑धसं दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं न॑यन्तु नः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, etc., as in XXXIII. 89.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in
 verse 6.

37.d: म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ सि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ सि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ सि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for
 Makha's head! Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for
 Makha, thee for Makha's head! Thou art the head of
 Makha, thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head!
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in
 verse 6.

37.d: अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Thee on Gods’ sacrificial ground with stallion's dung I
 fumigate.
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!
 For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha
 thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee
 for the head of Makha!

37.d: ऋ॒जवे॑ त्वा । सा॒धवे॑ त्वा । सु॑क्षित्यै त्वा । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।।
37.e:
Thee for the True. Thee for the Good. Thee for the place
 of happy rest.

For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha
 thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee
 for the head of Makha!

37.d: य॒माय॑ त्वा । म॒खाय॑ त्वा । सूर्य॑स्य त्वा॒ तप॑से । दे॒वस्त्वा॑ सवि॒ता मध्वा॑नक्तु । पृ॑थि॒व्याः सँ॒स्पृश॑स्पाहि । अ॒र्चिर॑सि शो॒चिर॑सि॒ तपो॑ सि ।।
37.e:
For Yama thee. For Makha thee. For Sûrya's fervent
 ardour thee.
 May Savitar the God with balm anoint thee. Guard thou
 the touches of the earth.
 Flame art thou; thou art radiance; thou art heat.

37.d: अना॑धृष्टा पु॒रस्ता॑द॒ग्नेराधि॑पत्य॒ आयु॑र्मे दाः । पु॒त्रव॑ती दक्षिण॒त इन्द्र॒स्याधि॑पत्ये प्र॒जां मे॑ दाः । सु॒षदा॑ प॒श्चाद्दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुराधि॑पत्ये॒ चक्षु॑र्मे दाः । आस्रु॑तिरुत्तर॒तो धा॒तुराधि॑पत्ये रा॒यस्पोषं॑ मे दाः । विधृ॑तिरु॒परि॑ष्टा॒द्बृह॒स्पते॒राधि॑पत्ये॒ ओजो॑ मे दाः । विश्वा॑भ्यो मा ना॒ष्ट्राभ्य॑स्पाहि । मनो॒रश्वा॑सि ।।
37.e:
Unconquerable, eastward, in Agni's overlordship, give me life.
 Rich in sons, southward, in Indra's overlordship give me
 offspring.
 Fair-seated, westward, in God. Savitar's overlordship, give
 me sight.
 Range of hearing, northward, in Dhâtar's overlordship, give
 me increase of wealth.
 Arrangement, upward, in Brihaspati's overlordship, give me
 energy.
 From all destructive spirits guard us. Thou art Manu's mare.

37.d: स्वाहा॑ म॒रुद्भिः॒ परि॑ श्रीयस्व । दि॒वः सँ॒स्पृश॑स्पाहि । मधु॒ मधु॒ मधु॑ ।।
37.e:
All-hail! By Maruts be thou compassed round.
 Guard the sky's touches. Mead, mead, mead.

37.d: गर्भो॑ दे॒वानां॑ पि॒ता म॑ती॒नां पतिः॑ प्र॒जाना॑म् । सं दे॒वो दे॒वेन॑ सवि॒त्रा ग॑त॒ सँ सूर्ये॑ण रोचते ।।
37.e:
Germ of the Gods, Father of hymns, all living creatures’
 guardian Lord,
 Radiant, with radiant Savitar united, with the Sun he shines.

37.d: सम॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॑ गत॒ सं दै॑वेन सवि॒त्रा सँ सूर्ये॑णारोचिष्ट । स्वाहा॒ सम॒ग्निस्तप॑सा गत॒ सं दै॑व्येन सवि॒त्रा सँ सूर्ये॑णारूरुचत ।।
37.e:
Agni combined with flaming fire, combined with Savitar
 divine, hath shone together with the Sun.

37.d: ध॒र्ता दि॒वो वि भा॑ति॒ तप॑सस्पृथि॒व्यां ध॒र्ता दे॒वो दे॒वाना॒मम॑र्त्यस्तपो॒जाः । वाच॑मस्मे॒ नि य॑च्छ देवा॒युव॑म् ।।
37.e:
He shines on earth upholder of the sky and heat, the Gods
 upholder, God, immortal, born of heat.
 To him address a speech devoted to the Gods.

37.d: अप॑श्यं गो॒पामनि॑पद्यमान॒मा च॒ परा॑ च प॒थिभि॒श्चर॑न्तम् । स स॒ध्रीचीः॒ स विषू॑ची॒र्वसा॑न॒ आ व॑रीवर्त्ति॒ भुव॑नेष्व॒न्तः ।।
37.e:
I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching
 by his pathways and departing.
 He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within
 the worlds continually travels.

37.d: विश्वा॑सां भुवां पते॒ विश्व॑स्य मनसस्पते॒ विश्व॑स्य वचसस्पते॒ सर्व॑स्य वचसस्पते । दे॑व॒श्रुत्त्वं दे॑व घर्म दे॒वो दे॒वान्पा॑हि । अत्र॒ प्रावी॒रनु॑ वां दे॒ववी॑तये । मधु॒ माध्वी॑भ्यां॒ मधु॒ माधू॑चीभ्याम् ।।
37.e:
Lord of all earths, Lord of all mind, Lord of all speech,
 thou Lord of speech entire.
 Heard by the Gods, Caldron divine, do thou, a God, protect
 the Gods.
 Here, after, let it speed you twain on to the banquet of the
 Gods.
 Sweetness for both the sweetness-lovers! Sweetness for
 those the twain who take delight in sweetness!

37.d: हृ॒दे त्वा॒ मन॑से त्वा दि॒वे त्वा॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा । ऊ॒र्ध्वो अ॑ध्व॒रं दि॒वि दे॒वेषु॑ धेहि ।।
37.e:
Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the sky, for
 Sûrya thee.
 Standing erect lay thou the sacrifice in heaven among the
 Gods.

37.d: पि॒ता नो॑ सि पि॒ता नो॑ बोधि॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिँसीः । त्वष्टृ॑मन्तस्त्वा सपेम पु॒त्रान्प॒शून्मयि॑ धेहि प्र॒जाम॒स्मासु॑ धे॒ह्यरि॑ष्टा॒हँ स॒हप॑त्या भूयासम् ।।
37.e:
Thou art our Father, father-like regard us. Obeisance be to
 thee. Do not thou harm us.
 May we, accompanied by Tvashtar, win thee. Vouchsafe me
 sons and cattle. Grant us offspring. Safe may I be together
 with my husband.

37.d: अहः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताँ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ । रात्रिः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताँ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
37.e:
May Day together with his sheen, pair-lighted with his light,
 accept. All-hail!
 May Night together with her sheen, fair lighted with her.
 light, accept. All-hail!

38.d: दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वे॒ श्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॒दे दि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॑सि ।।
38.e:
-EIGHTH.

BY impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins,
 with the Hands of Pûshan.
 A zone for Aditi art thou.

38.d: इड॒ एहि॑ । अदि॑त॒ एहि॑ । सर॑स्व॒त्त्येहि॑ । असा॒वेहि॑ । असा॒वेहि॑ । असा॒वेहि॑ ।।
38.e:
Idâ, come hither. Aditi, come hither. Sarasvatî, come
 hither.
 Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-So. Come
 hither, So-and-So.

38.d: अदि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॑सीन्द्रा॒ण्या उ॒ष्णीषः॑ । पू॒षासि॑ । घ॒र्माय॑ दीष्व ।।
38.e:
Thou art a zone for Aditi, a diadem for Indrânî. Pûshan art
 thou. Spare some for the Gharma.

38.d: अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ पिन्वस्व । सर॑स्वत्पिन्वस्व । इन्द्रा॑य पिन्वस्व । स्वाहेन्द्र॑वत् । स्वाहेन्द्र॑वत् । स्वाहेन्द्र॑वत् ।।
38.e:
Overflow for the Asvins. Overflow for Sarasvatî. Overflow
 for Indra
 All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to
 Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra!

38.d: यस्ते॒ स्तनः॑ शश॒यो यो म॑यो॒भूर्यो र॑त्न॒धा व॑सु॒विद्यः सु॒दत्रः॑ । येन॒ विश्वा॒ पुष्य॑सि॒ वार्या॑णि॒ सर॑स्व॒त्तमि॒ह धात॑वे कः । उ॒र्व॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मन्वे॑मि ।।
38.e:
That breast of thine, exhaustless, fount of pleasure, wealth-giver,
 treasure-finder, free-bestower,
 Wherewith thou rearest all things that are choicest,—bring
 that, Sarasvatî, that we may drain it.
 Throughout the spacious middle air I travel.

38.d: गा॑य॒त्रं छन्दो॑ सि । त्रै॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्दो॑ सि । द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ परि॑ गृह्णामि । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒णोप॑ यच्छामि । इन्द्रा॑श्विना । मधु॑नः सार॒घस्य॑ घ॒र्मं पा॑त॒ वस॑वो॒ यज॑त॒ वाट् । स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मये॑ वृष्टि॒वन॑ये ।।
38.e:
Thou art Gâyatra metre. Thou art Trishtup metre. With
 Heaven and Earth I grasp thee. With the Firmament I
 raise thee up.
 Indra and Asvins, drink ye the hot draught of sweet honey:
 sacrifice, ye Vasus. Vât! All-hail to the rain-winning
 beam of the Sun!

38.d: स॑मु॒द्राय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । स॑रि॒राय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॑नाधृ॒ष्याय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॑प्रतिधृ॒ष्याय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॑व॒स्यवे॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॑शिमि॒दाय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
38.e:
Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta
 the flood.
 Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with
 Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible.
 Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with
 Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.

38.d: इन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ वसु॑मते रु॒द्रव॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ । इन्द्रा॑य त्वादि॒त्यव॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ । इन्द्रा॑य त्वाभिमाति॒घ्ने स्वाहा॑ । स॑वि॒त्रे त्व॑ ऋभु॒मते॑ विभु॒मते॒ वाज॑वते॒ स्वाहा॑ । बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
38.e:
Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ
 to Indra Lord of Rudras.
 Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ
 to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee
 with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.

38.d: य॒माय॒ त्वाङ्गि॑रस्वते पितृ॒मते॒ स्वाहा॑ । स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्माय॑ । स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्मः पि॒त्रे ।।
38.e:
Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the
 Fathers!
 Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!

38.d: विश्वा॒ आशा॑ दक्षिण॒सद्विश्वा॑न्दे॒वानया॑डि॒ह । स्वाहा॑कृतस्य घ॒र्मस्य॒ मधोः॑ पिबतमश्विना ।।
38.e:
Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions,
 all the Gods.
 Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated
 mead.

38.d: दि॒वि धा॑ इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒मम्य॒ज्ञं दि॒वि धाः॑ । स्वाहा॒ग्नये॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑य॒ शं यजु॑र्भ्यः ।।
38.e:
In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in
 heaven.
 To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.

38.d: अश्वि॑ना घ॒र्मं पा॑तँ॒ हार्द्वा॑न॒मह॑र्दि॒वाभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ । त॑न्त्रा॒यिणो॒ नमो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॑म् ।।
38.e:
Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener
 of hearts.
 To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to
 Heaven and Earth.

38.d: अपा॑ताम॒श्विना॑ घ॒र्ममनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑मँसाताम् । इहै॒व रा॒तयः॑ सन्तु ।।
38.e:
The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and
 Earth have they agreed.
 Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.

38.d: इ॒षे पि॑न्वस्व । ऊ॒र्जे पि॑न्वस्व । ब्रह्म॑णे पिन्वस्व । क्ष॒त्राय॑ पिन्वस्व । द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ पिन्वस्व । धर्मा॑सि सु॒धर्म॑ । अमे॑न्य॒स्मे नृ॒म्णानि॑ धारय॒ ब्रह्म॑ धारय क्ष॒त्रम्धा॑रय॒ विषं॑ धारय ।।
38.e:
Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the
 Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for
 Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty.
 Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the
 People.

38.d: स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे शर॑से । स्वाहा॒ ग्राव॑भ्यः । स्वाहा॑ प्रतिर॒वेभ्यः॑ । स्वाहा॑ पि॒तृभ्य॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वब॑र्हिर्भ्यो घर्म॒पाव॑भ्यः । स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॑म् । स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यः दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ।।
38.e:
All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the
 press-stones!
 All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are
 above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to
 Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!

38.d: स्वाहा॑ रु॒द्राय॑ रु॒द्रहू॑तये । स्वाहा॒ सं ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योतिः॑ । अहः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताँ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ । रात्रिः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताँ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ । मधु॑ हु॒तमिन्द्र॑तमे अ॒ग्नाव॒श्याम॑ ते देव॒ घर्म॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिँसीः ।।
38.e:
All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let
 light combine with light.
 May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light,
 accept. All hail!
 May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her
 light, accept. All-hail!
 May we enjoy the mead offered in most Indra-like Agni.
 Homage to thee, divine Gharma! Do not thou injure me.

38.d: अ॒भी॒मं म॑हि॒मा दिवं॒ विप्रो॑ बभूव स॒प्रथाः॑ । उ॒त श्रव॑सा पृथि॒वीँ सँ सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ अ॑सि॒ रोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः ।।
38.e:
Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath
 surpassed this heaven,
 And, with its glorious fame, the earth.
 Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of
 the Gods.
 Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy
 and beautiful to see.

38.d: या ते॑ घर्म दि॒व्या शुग्या गा॑य॒त्र्याँ ह॑वि॒र्धाने॑ । सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्प्या॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ । या ते॑ घर्मा॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ शुग्या त्रि॒ष्टुभ्याग्नी॑ध्रे । सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्प्या॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ । या ते॑ घर्म पृथि॒व्याँ शुग्या जग॑त्याँ सद॒स्या॑ । सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्प्या॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
38.e:
Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the
 Soma-store,—
 May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.
 Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred
 hearth,—
 May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.
 Gharma, that light of thine on earth, in Jagatî, of the priest's
 shed,—
 May that increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.

38.d: क्ष॒त्रस्य॑ त्वा प॒रस्पा॑य॒ ब्रह्म॑णस्त॒न्वं॑ पाहि । विश॑स्त्वा॒ धर्म॑णा व॒यमनु॑ क्रामाम सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से ।।
38.e:
Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou
 from injury the Brahman's body.
 We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of
 our peace and comfort.

38.d: चतुः॑स्रक्ति॒र्नाभि॑रृ॒तस्य॑ स॒प्रथाः॒ स नो॑ वि॒श्वायुः॑ स॒प्रथाः॒ स नः॑ स॒र्वायुः॑ स॒प्रथाः॑ । अप॒ द्वेषो॒ अप॒ ह्वरो॒ न्यव्र॑तस्य सश्चिम ।।
38.e:
Square, far-spread is the sacrifice's navel: it spreads for us
 wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of
 complete existence.
 We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an
 alien law.

38.d: घर्मै॒तत्ते॒ पुरी॑षं॒ तेन॒ वर्ध॑स्व॒ चा च॑ प्यायस्व । व॑र्धिषी॒महि॑ च व॒यमा च॑ प्यासिषीमहि ।।
38.e:
This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in
 strength thereby.
 May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.

38.d: अचि॑क्रद॒द्वृषा॒ हरि॑र्म॒हान्मि॒त्रो न॑ दर्श॒तः । सँ सूर्ये॑ण दिद्युतदुद॒धिर्नि॒धिः ।।
38.e:
Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see.
 Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with
 flashing light.

38.d: सु॑मित्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु+ दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ यो॒ स्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ।।
38.e:
To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who
 hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

38.d: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वः॒ पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ।।
38.e:
Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come
 To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

38.d: एधो॑ स्येधिषी॒महि॑ । स॒मिद॑सि॒ तेजो॑ सि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।।
38.e:
A brand art thou, fain would we thrive, Fuel art thou, and
 splendour: Give me splendour,

38.d: याव॑तो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी याव॑च्च स॒प्त सिन्ध॑वो वितस्थि॒रे । तव॑न्तमिन्द्र ते॒ ग्रह॑मू॒र्जा गृ॑ह्णा॒म्यक्षि॑तं॒ मयि॑ गृह्णा॒म्यक्षि॑तम् ।।
38.e:
Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as
 the Seven Rivers are extended,
 So vast thy cup which I with strength am taking, Indra,
 unharmed in me, uninjured ever.

38.d: मयि॒ त्यदि॑न्द्रि॒यं बृ॒हन्मयि॒ दक्षो॒ मयि॒ क्रतुः॑ । घ॒र्मस्त्रि॒शुग्वि रा॑जति वि॒राजा॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह ब्रह्म॑णा॒ तेज॑सा स॒ह ।।
38.e:
In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and
 mental force:
 The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent
 far away, with holy lore, with brilliancy.

38.d: पय॑सो॒ रेत॒ आभृ॑तं॒ तस्य॒ दोह॑मशीम॒ह्युत्त॑राम्ुत्तराँ॒ समा॑म् । त्विषः॑ सं॒वृक्क्रत्वे॒ दक्ष॑स्य ते सुषुवा॒णस्य॑ ते सुषुम्णाग्निहु॒तः । इन्द्र॑पीतस्य प्र॒जाप॑तिभक्षितस्य॒ मधु॑मत॒ उप॑हूत॒ उप॑हूतस्य भक्षयामि ।।
38.e:
Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through each succeeding
 year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it.
 Invited, I enjoy a share of that which hath been offered me,
 the savoury draught by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajâpati.

39.d: स्वाहा॑प्रा॒णेभ्यः॒ साधि॑पतिकेभ्यः । पृ॑थिव्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ स्वाहा॑ । वा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॑ । दि॒वे स्वाहा॑ । सूर्या॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
-NINTH.

SVÂHÂ to the Vital Breathings with their Controlling Lord!
 To Earth Svâhâ! To Agni Svâhâ! To Firmament, Svâhâ!
 To Vâyu Svâhâ! To Sky Svâhâ! To Sûrya Svâhâ!

39.d: दि॒ग्भ्यः स्वाहा॑ । च॒न्द्राय॒ स्वाहा॑ । नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ । अ॒द्भ्यः स्वाहा॑ । वरु॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ । नाभ्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ । पू॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To the Quarters Svâhâ! To the Moon Svâhâ! To the Stars
 Svâhâ! To the Waters Svâhâ! To Varuna Svâhâ! To
 the Navel Svâhâ! To the Purified Svâhâ!

39.d: वा॒चे स्वाहा॑ । प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ । प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ । चक्षु॑षे॒ स्वाहा॑ । चक्षु॑षे॒ स्वाहा॑ । श्रोत्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ । श्रोत्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To Speech Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ! To Breath Svâhâ!
 To Sight Svâhâ! To Sight Svâhâ! To Hearing Svâhâ!
 To Hearing Svâhâ!

39.d: मन॑सः॒ काम॒माकू॑तिं वा॒चः स॒त्यम॑शीय । प॑शू॒नाँ रू॒पमन्न॑स्य॒ रसो॒ यशः॒ श्रीः श्र॑यतां॒ मयि॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
The wish and purpose of the mind and truth of speech may
 I obtain.
 Bestowed on me be cattle's form, swept taste of food, and
 fame and grace. Svâhâ!

39.d: प्र॒जाप॑तिः संभ्रि॒यमा॑णः स॒म्राट्संभृ॑तो वैश्वदे॒वः सँ॑स॒न्नो घ॒र्मः प्रवृ॑क्त॒स्तेज॒ उद्य॑त आश्वि॒नः पय॑स्यानी॒यमा॑ने पौ॒ष्णो विष्प॒न्दमा॑ने मारु॒तः क्लथ॑न् । मै॒त्रः शर॑सि संता॒य्यमा॑ने वाय॒व्यो॑ ह्रि॒यमा॑ण आग्ने॒यो हू॒यमा॑नो॒ वाग्घु॒तः ।।

स॑वि॒ता प्र॑थ॒मे ह॑न्न॒ग्निर्द्वि॒तीये॑ वा॒युस्तृ॒तीय॑ आदि॒त्यश्च॑तु॒र्थे च॒न्द्रमाः॑ पञ्च॒म ऋ॒तुः ष॒ष्ठे म॒रुतः॑ सप्त॒मे बृह॒स्पति॑रष्ट॒मे । मि॒त्रो न॑व॒मे वरु॑णो दश॒म इन्द्र॑ एकाद॒शे विश्वे॑ दे॒वा द्वा॑द॒शे ।।
39.e:
Savitar on the first day; Agni on the second; Vâyu on the
 third; Âditya (the Sun) on the fourth; Chandramâs (the
 Moon) on the fifth; Ritu on the sixth; the Maruts on
 the seventh; Brihaspati on the eighth; Mitra on the
 ninth; Varuna on the tenth; Indra on the eleventh;
 the All-Gods on the twelfth.

39.d: उ॒ग्रश्च॑ भी॒मश्च॒ ध्वा॑न्तश्च॒ धुनि॑श्च । सा॑स॒ह्वाँश्चा॑भियु॒ग्वा च॑ वि॒क्षिपः॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
Fierce; Terrible; The Resonant; The Roarer; Victorious;
 Assailant; and Dispeller. Svâhâ.

39.d: अ॒ग्निँ हृद॑येना॒शनिँ॑ हृदया॒ग्रेण॑ पशु॒पतिं॑ कृत्स्न॒हृद॑येन भ॒वं य॒क्ना । श॒र्वं मत॑स्नाभ्या॒मीशा॑नं म॒न्युना॑ महादे॒वम॑न्तःपर्श॒व्येनो॒ग्रं दे॒वं व॑नि॒ष्ठुना॑ वसिष्ठ॒हनुः॒ शिङ्गी॑नि को॒श्याभ्या॑म् ।।

उ॒ग्रं लोहि॑तेन मि॒त्रँ सौ॑व्रत्येन रु॒द्रं दौ॑र्व्रत्ये॒नेन्द्रं॑ प्रक्री॒डेन॑ म॒रुतो॒ बले॑न सा॒ध्यान्प्र॒मुदा॑ । भ॒वस्य॒ कण्ठँ॑ रु॒द्रस्या॑न्तःपा॒र्श्व्यं म॑हादे॒वस्य॒ यकृ॑च्छ॒र्वस्य॑ वनि॒ष्ठुः प॑शु॒पतेः॑ पुरी॒तत् ।।
39.e:
The Fierce with blood; Mitra with obedience, Rudra with
 disobedience; Indra with pastime; the Maruts with
 strength; the Sâdhyas with enjoyment.
 Bhava's is what is on the throat; Rudra's what is between
 the ribs; Mahâdeva's is the liver; Sarva's the rectum;
 Pasupati's the pericardium.

39.d: लोम॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ लोम॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ त्व॒चे स्वाहा॑ त्व॒चे स्वाहा॒ लोहि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ लोहि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ मेदो॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ मेदो॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ । माँ॒सेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ माँ॒सेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ स्नाव॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ स्नाव॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒स्थभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒स्थभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ म॒ज्जभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ म॒ज्जभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ । रेत॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ पा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To the hair Svâhâ! To the hair Svâhâ! To the skin Svâhâ!
 To the skin Svâhâ! To the blood Svâhâ! To the blood
 Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the fats Svâhâ! To the
 fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the fleshy parts Svâhâ! To the
 sinews Svâhâ! To the sinews Svâhâ! Svâhâ to the bones!
 Svâhâ to the bones! To the marrows Svâhâ! To the
 marrows Svâhâ! To the seed Svâhâ! To the anus Svâhâ!

39.d: आ॑या॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ प्राया॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ संया॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ विया॒साय॒ स्वाहो॑द्या॒साय॒ स्वाहा॑ । शु॒चे स्वाहा॒ शोच॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ शोच॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॒ शोका॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To Effort Svâhâ! To Exertion Svâhâ! To Endeavour Svâhâ!
 To Viyâsa Svâhâ! To Attempt Svâhâ!

39.d: तप॑से॒ स्वाहा॒ तप्य॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ तप्य॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॑ त॒प्ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्माय॒ स्वाहा॑ । निष्कृ॑त्यै॒ स्वाहा॒ प्राय॑श्चित्त्यै॒ स्वाहा॑भेष॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To Grief Svâhâ! To the Grieving Svâhâ! To the Sorrowing
 Svâhâ! To Sorrow Svâhâ!
 To Heat Svâhâ! To him who grows hot Svâhâ! To him
 who is being heated Svâhâ! To him who has been heated
 Svâhâ! To Gharma Svâhâ!
 To Atonement Svâhâ! To Expiation Svâhâ! To Remedy
 Svâhâ!

39.d: य॒माय॒ स्वाहान्त॑काय॒ स्वाहा॑ मृ॒त्यवे॒ स्वाहा॒ ब्रह्म॑णे॒ स्वाहा॑ ब्रह्मह॒त्यायै॒ स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्याँ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
39.e:
To Yama Svâhâ! To the Finisher Svâhâ! To Death Svâhâ!
 To the Priesthood Svâhâ! To Brâhmanicide Svâhâ! To
 the All-Gods Svâhâ! To Heaven and Earth Svâhâ!

40.d: ईशा वास्यमिदँ सर्वं यत्किं च जगत्यां जगत् । तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्य स्विद्धनम् ॥
40.e:
ENVELOPED by the Lord must be This All—each thing that
 moves on earth.
 With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of
 any man.

40.d: कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतँ समाः । एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतो स्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे ॥
40.e:
One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred
 years.
 No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not
 to man.

40.d: असुर्या नाम ते लोका अन्धेन तमसावृताः । ताँस्ते प्रेत्यापि गच्छन्ति ये के चात्महनो जनाः ॥
40.e:
Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding
 gloom.
 To them, when life on earth is done, depart the men who
 kill the Self.

40.d: अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयो नैनद्देवा आप्नुवन्पूर्वमर्शत् । तद्धावतो न्यानत्येति तिष्ठत्तस्मिन्नपो मातरिश्वा दधाति ॥
40.e:
Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to
 o’ertake it speeding on before them.
 It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein Both
 Mâtarisvan stablish Action.

40.d: तदेजति तन्नैजति तद्दूरे तद्वन्तिके । तदन्तरस्य सर्वस्य तदु सरवस्यास्य बाह्यतः ॥
40.e:
It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near.
 It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.

40.d: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्नेवानुपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न वि चिकित्सति ॥
40.e:
The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things
 that be,
 And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer,
 ponders not.

40.d: यस्मिन्त्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः । तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः ॥
40.e:
When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all
 things that are,

What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the
 One alone?

40.d: स पर्यगाच्छुक्रमकायमव्रणमस्नाविरँ शुद्धमपापविद्धम् । कविर्मनीषी परिभूः स्वयंभूर्याथातथ्यतो र्थान्व्यदधाच्छाश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः ॥
40.e:
He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless,
 Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced.
 Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath
 prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the
 everlasting Years.

40.d: अन्धं तमः प्र विशन्ति ये संभूतिमुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ संभूत्याँ रताः ॥
40.e:
Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhûti's
 worshippers.
 They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhûti are
 intent.

40.d: अन्यदेवाहुः संभवादन्यदाहुर्शंभवात् । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥
40.e:
One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava.
 Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this
 lore to us.

40.d: संभूतिं च विनाशं च यस्तद्वेदोभयँ सह । विनाशेन मृत्युं तीर्त्वा संभूत्यामृतमश्नुते ॥
40.e:
The man who knows Sambhûti and Vinâsa simultaneously,
 He, by Vinâsa passing death, gains by Sambhûti endless life.

40.d: अन्धं तमः प्र विशन्ति ये विद्यामुपासते । ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ विद्यायाँ रताः ॥
40.e:
To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of
 Nescience.
 The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.

40.d: अन्यदेवाहुर्विद्याया अन्यदाहुरविद्यायाः । इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे ॥
40.e:
Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience.
 Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this
 lore to us.

40.d: विद्यां चाविद्यां च यस्तद्वेदोभयँ सह । अविद्यया मृत्युं तीर्त्वा विद्ययामृतमश्नुते ॥
40.e:
The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience,
 combined,
 O’ercoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless
 life.

40.d: वायुरनिलममृतमथेदं भस्मान्तँ शरीरम् । ॐ क्रतो स्मर क्लिबे स्मर कृतँ स्मर ॥
अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भुयिष्ठां ते नमउक्तिं विधेम ॥
40.e:
By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who
 knowest all our works and wisdom.
 Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most
 ample adoration will we bring thee.

40.d: हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम् । यो सावादित्ये पुरुषः सो सावहम् । ॐ खं ब्रह्म ॥
40.e:
The Real's face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light.
 The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I.
 OM! Heaven! Brahma!
